title: Brand Manager (crafts)| DTC E-commerce | 100% Remote EU
description:
At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us..

**The role**

We're hiring a Brand Manager to own This Month's Craft end to end, with churn as your main KPI. This Month's Craft is a monthly craft subscription box with two tracks: Creative (relaxing, artistic crafts) and DIY (practical, skill-building crafts).

Your biggest lever on churn is the box: finding, testing, and approving crafts that subscribers love and actually finish. You'll also analyse who we acquire, how the cancellation flow and failed-payment recovery perform, and work closely with customer service and analyze customer feedback. Just as important: you dig into why things happen and check whether each change actually worked. We need your product judgement and your ownership.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Find, test and approve the crafts.** Own the box pipeline for both tracks. Scout craft ideas, order samples, make every kit yourself, and approve or reject it.
* **Own kit quality.** Every kit must be finishable at its stated level: clear instructions, the right tools and materials, nothing missing, packaging that survives shipping. Catch problems before a box ships, not in the reviews.
* **Plan the box calendar.** Balance variety, seasonality and difficulty across Creative and DIY, within the cost-per-box target.
* **Learn from subscribers.** Read and summarize reviews, CS tickets, community posts and cancellation reasons every month, and use them to shape the boxes.
* **Own churn.** It's your main KPI. Understand what drives it by box, channel and track, and act on it.
* **Protect acquisition quality.** Work with performance marketing on channels and first-box offers, and avoid offers that attract one-box buyers.
* **Keep the subscription running smoothly.** Own the cancellation flow (reasons, offers, copy) and failed-payment recovery, with saves that still hold a month later.
* **Stay aligned with Customer Service.** Turn recurring ticket themes into fixes, and close the loop with CS when they ship.

**Skills & experience**
-----------------------

**Must have**

* 1+ years in consumer product development, merchandising or brand management, ideally with craft kits, hobby products or subscription boxes.
* A track record of products you chose or developed, and how customers responded: ratings, sell-through, repeat purchases, returns.
* A hands-on maker. You craft yourself, and you can make a kit and judge its difficulty, instructions and quality.
* Supplier experience: sourcing samples, negotiating, and working to cost targets and lead times.
* Taste grounded in customers. You use reviews and feedback to decide, not only your own preferences.
* Ownership across teams. You push work through with marketing, CS, design, inventory and operations without being chased.
* Comfort with numbers. You can read a retention table and question a figure that looks too good, connect reason with outcome based on numbers
* Clear written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience running a subscription box.
* Experience writing craft instructions.
* An active presence in craft communities or social media.
* Experience with Shopify.
* Spreadsheet analysis skills.

**THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS**

* Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world.
* Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space.
* Test Task
* Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together.

**FIXED SERVICE FEE**

**Up to € 2300 euros** after taxes, depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience.

Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement.

**ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS**

This role is 100% remote.

At Foxelli Group, our team operates primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET), which is **UTC+2** and **UTC+3**. We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
description:
**About Pleo**
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
  
  
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
  
  
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!
  
  
**Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.**
**Who You’ll Be Working With And Reporting To**
You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:
  
  

* Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.
* The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.
* Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.
* Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.
* Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

**What You Bring**
You’ll thrive in this role if you have:
  
  

* A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.
* Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).
* High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.
* Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.
* Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.
* A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

**Why is this role a good fit for you**
This role is a good fit for you if:
  
  

* You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.
* You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.
* You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:
  
  

* You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.
* You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.
* You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

**How You’ll Develop In This Role**
In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:
  
  

* Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.
* Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.
* Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

**The location**
Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.
  
  
**Show me the benefits!**

* Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
* Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
* Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
* 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).
* For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
* We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
* Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

**The interview process**
We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:
  
  

* Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
* Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience
* Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
* Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!
  
  
Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:
  
  

* CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!
* Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
* Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

**About Your Application**

* English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
* A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
* Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
* Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
* Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
* Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
* Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Content Marketer (SEO & AI Search)
description:
**Join Reach as our Content Marketer (focused on SEO & AI Search)!**
You'll define what content engineering at the highest level looks like, then execute it for some of the best companies in the world. You'll shape how our proprietary platform automates content workflows, deciding what scales with humans and what scales with software. And as we grow, you'll build a team to scale production without sacrificing quality.
  
  
This is not a traditional content manager role. You'll combine deep SEO knowledge, advanced AI-powered production workflows, visual design skills, and LinkedIn content expertise to produce and scale high-quality content across our entire customer portfolio and for Reach itself.
  
  
**About Reach**
At Reach we're building the operating system to help companies monitor and control their visibility in AI search. We built a proprietary platform that combines our software, custom AI agents, and forward-deployed experts from the top 1% in organic growth (SEO & AEO), to help companies show up when buyers are researching and comparing solutions on Google and inside AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity, and turn that visibility into pipeline and revenue.
  
  
We reached $1.4M ARR in 14 months, basically bootstrapped, and we're scaling to $10M ARR by the end of 2027. We've been doing this for companies like ColdIQ ($7M ARR, #1 Clay worldwide sales agency), Indie Campers ($140M+ ARR), Carro, Fidelidade, Fraudio, Noxus and others.
  
  
A few recent results:
  
  

* Grew Indie Campers' revenue attributed to AI search by +1,318.62% YoY (14x) and organic search revenue by +7.85% YoY across 2025, delivered during a full website migration. Read the case study.
* Helped ColdIQ influence $506K in signed contract value from organic and AI search in ~4 months, making SEO and AI search their #1 traffic source with organic traffic up 7.3x. Read the case study.
* Took Carro from a 0% to 34.58% AI citation rate (4.5x the nearest competitor) and the #3 most-cited domain in their category, now consistently closing 7-figure deals sourced from AI search. Read the case study.

You can see more of the results we drive for our customers here.
  
  
We're turning services into software to disrupt the $100B+ SEO/AI Search market, which will get drastically bigger as search behavior shifts to AI and ad budgets follow.
  
  
"The global SEO and AEO services market will grow to $171 billion by 2030 from $81.4 billion last year", Wall Street Journal
  
  
**The team**
We're a team of founders, AI engineers, and SEO & AEO specialists passionate about creating a category defining company that moves fast and has fun doing it.
  
  
Here's a look at what life on the team is like. This is our latest company retreat:
  
  
Our founders have a proven track record of building and scaling fast growing tech companies. Jose Velez (CEO) was the solo founder & CEO of Rely.io, an internal developer portal used by top engineering orgs like ESPN Bet and Feedzai, and launched AI products that reached #1 Product of the Day and #1 AI Product of the month on Product Hunt. He raised $3.6M from top-tier firms like J12 Ventures, Shilling Capital Partners, Techstars NYC, and TheVentureCity, as well as from notable angels.
  
  
Bernardo Ferreira (founding AI search strategist) led the strategy behind more than
**250M organic visits**
and
**€100M in revenue attributed to SEO**
at Worten (think Iberian Amazon) in 2024.
  
  
**Location**
For this role, we're open to it being remote, mainly because we're growing fast and we can't afford to limit ourselves. That said, we care deeply about working in person.
  
  
If you can work alongside us from our Lisbon hub, that's our preference:
  
  
→ Lisbon: with the founding team day-to-day, plus regular travel to the US.
  
  
If you can move to Lisbon, we'll support relocation including visa sponsorship where possible.
  
  
Either way, expect to travel a lot.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for a builder-leader: someone who sets a new standard for what SEO content production looks like in the AI era, and then builds the systems and team to scale it.
  
  
You will own three things:
  
  

* Define What Content Engineering at the Highest Level Looks Like, and Execute It

This is not about pasting a keyword into ChatGPT and editing the output. You'll build the workflows, set the bar, and ship content for some of the best companies in the world.
  
  

* Build and use advanced AI content pipelines. Use Claude Code, custom agents, programmatic approaches, and whatever tools give you leverage to produce content at 5-10x the pace of a traditional content team, with higher quality. Show us your setup. If you can't walk us through your AI workflow and impress us with how you use it for research, drafting, editing, analysis, and optimization, you won't pass the interview.
* Ship content that drives revenue, not just rankings. Blog posts, comparison pages, use case pages, landing pages, how-to guides, community responses for Reddit, Quora, and G2. Every piece of content is optimized for both search engines and AI models, on-brand, accurate, and genuinely useful for the target buyer.
* Create visual content that gets saved and shared. LinkedIn infographics, data visualizations, carousels, comparison graphics, process diagrams. You don't just write. You design. You need a strong eye and the ability to produce polished visual content quickly using tools like Figma, Canva, or equivalent.
* Write LinkedIn content that generates pipeline. Posts for Jose's personal brand, Reach's company page, and customer accounts. You understand hooks, storytelling, visual formats, and what drives B2B engagement on LinkedIn.
* Set the quality bar. Excellent writer who can adapt voice and tone across different brands and industries. Deep on-page SEO knowledge: keyword placement, heading structure, internal linking, meta tags, schema markup, content structure. Every piece you ship is the reference standard for what "great" looks like.
* Improve our platform and the content system

Your expertise doesn't just serve customers. It becomes the product.
  
  

* Be the power user who shapes the AI content tools. You'll use our AI agents daily for content production. Your feedback on what works, what's slow, and what's missing directly influences the product roadmap.
* Identify what scales with humans vs. what scales with software. Some content requires editorial judgment, deep brand knowledge, and creative thinking. Some content can be templated, automated, or generated programmatically. You'll help us draw that line correctly, and push it further every month.
* Build workflows that scale. Create templates, processes, and automations that let you produce 15-20 pieces of optimized content per month across multiple customer accounts without dropping quality. Document everything so it's transferable.
* Close the loop with Strategy and Engineering. Work with our Growth Strategists to translate content briefs and action plans into finished, published content. Feed patterns back to Engineering: what should the agents handle, what needs human attention, and where the gaps are.
* Push the boundaries of programmatic content. If there's a way to generate structured, high-quality pages at scale using data and templates, find it. If a content type can be partially automated, build the workflow. Always with quality as the non-negotiable.
* Build and Lead a Team of World-Class Content Engineers

As we scale, you'll grow from individual contributor to team leader.
  
  

* Recruit and develop content talent. Hire people who combine writing ability, SEO depth, AI tooling mastery, and speed. Build a team that's genuinely better than any agency's content team.
* Hands-on leadership. Jump into content production, quality reviews, and customer accounts. Model excellence through action, not just direction.
* Build scalable systems. Create onboarding, training, and quality assurance processes that let new team members ramp fast and produce at your standard. Maintain customer knowledge bases that power personalized content generation.
* Manage multi-customer production. Coordinate content production across a portfolio of customers with different brands, voices, industries, and priorities. Ensure nothing slips.
* Define the craft. "Content engineer" is a new role. You'll define what it means, what the career path looks like, and how the best content engineers in the world work.

**Signs you’re a great fit…**

* You have 3+ years of experience producing SEO content for B2B/SaaS companies, with proven ranking and traffic results.
* You're an excellent writer who can adapt voice and tone across different brands and industries.
* You have an advanced AI workflow that goes far beyond "use ChatGPT to draft." You use Claude Code, custom agents, programmatic approaches, or similar tools, and you can show us a setup that's genuinely impressive.
* You understand on-page SEO deeply: keyword placement, heading structure, internal linking, meta tags, schema markup, and content structure.
* You can work with data and analytics: GSC, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and use them to prioritize what content to create or optimize.
* You have a strong design eye and can create infographics, LinkedIn visuals, and web pages that look polished and professional.
* You understand what works on LinkedIn: hooks, storytelling, visual formats, and engagement patterns.
* You're fast, organized, and can manage content production across multiple customers simultaneously without dropping quality.
* You use AI tools extensively and are obsessive about improving your setup.

**Bonus points:**

* Experience with programmatic SEO or templated content at scale
* Proficiency in Figma, Framer, Webflow, or similar design/web tools
* Experience writing content that targets AI search visibility (structured for LLM consumption)
* Technical comfort with Markdown, HTML, CSS, or light scripting
* A portfolio of LinkedIn infographics or visual content you've created
* Experience at a content-led agency or a startup where you owned the full content pipeline
* You've built content processes or playbooks that scaled a team's output
* Our job titles may encompass various career levels, and the actual base pay for this position will be determined based on multiple factors including training, transferable skills, work experience, business requirements, and market conditions. Additionally, this role is eligible for equity and comprehensive benefits.

* Ensure effective escalation, restoration and communication during major disruptions; drive rigorous root-cause analysis, permanent remediation and a reduction in recurring incidents and avoidable service demand.
* Establish meaningful service levels and experience measures (SLAs, XLAs and operational KPIs), and maintain a transparent view of quality, reliability, employee impact, risk, demand and improvement priorities.

**Security, controls and governance**

* Ensure workplace services operate within applicable security, privacy, regulatory and internal-control requirements, with clear operational ownership for risk, vulnerabilities, privileged support access and third-party obligations.
* Oversee audit readiness, control evidence, management actions, service-continuity arrangements and supplier resilience, ensuring risks are raised early, remediation is effective and accountability is clear.

**Managed services, commercial and financial leadership**

* Own Workplace Operations financial planning and performance, including operational budgets, forecasts, service cost drivers, workforce and supplier spend, investment cases and sustainable cost optimization.
* Lead strategic partner governance, sourcing and service transitions; manage vendors against contracted outcomes, quality, experience, innovation and value rather than resource counts alone.
* Maintain effective oversight of workplace technology assets, service contracts and relevant licence consumption, partnering with Finance, Procurement and product owners on lifecycle cost and value.

**Transformation and employee experience**

* Build an evidence-led improvement roadmap that uses employee feedback, digital experience telemetry, workflow automation, self-service and AI-assisted operations to reduce friction, prevent incidents and improve productivity.
* Own operational assurance and readiness for workplace transformations, large-scale technology deployments and provider changes, ensuring credible delivery capacity, support acceptance, communication, hypercare and business continuity.
* Strengthen the experience of critical employee journeys, including joining, moving, changing devices, seeking support and leaving, with measurable gains in quality, speed, cost and satisfaction.

**Organizational and executive leadership**

* Lead and develop a multi-region organization of 150+ employees through its service-management, regional Field Services and multimedia leaders; shape structure, talent, succession, workforce planning, performance and a culture of accountability.
* Serve as a member of the Digital Workplace leadership team and partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, HR, Facilities, Finance and business leaders to resolve cross-functional issues and translate strategy into reliable operations.
* Act as the senior escalation and decision point for critical service matters, communicating clearly with executives and making balanced decisions across employee experience, cost, risk, speed and resilience.

**About the team**

In GSTP Digital Workplace, we make it easy for Swiss Re employees to use their digital workplace to connect seamlessly with people, ideas and expertise across the company and beyond. We focus on translating internal client needs into workplace products and services that improve productivity, enable flexibility and support secure ways of working.

Digital Workplace provides the products, services and support that enable Swiss Re's workforce to work from anywhere, anytime, in a stable and secure environment. This includes collaboration, productivity, endpoints, workplace foundations, governance and emerging workplace capabilities such as AI.

Workplace Operations is the global delivery and service-management capability behind that experience. It brings together remote and onsite user support, global Field Services, multimedia technology services and operational governance, in close partnership with the engineering and product organizations accountable for the technology platforms.

**About you**

To be successful in this role, you are already an established senior leader of large-scale, global IT operations or Digital Workplace / End User Services. You bring direct accountability for a comparable operation, not only individual service-management processes, engineering platforms or transformation programmes.

You have led leaders across regions and time zones, managed significant internal and outsourced service capacity, and improved service quality while controlling cost and operational risk. You are credible with engineers and service providers, but you measure success through employee productivity, reliable services and business outcomes.

You combine executive presence, sound judgement and calm incident leadership with the ability to build a strong organization. You know when to challenge, when to empower and how to turn operational evidence into clear priorities and decisions.

**You have:**

* 15+ years in enterprise IT operations or Digital Workplace, including several years as a Director or Head of a significant global service organization.
* Prior end-to-end accountability for global remote support, onsite Field Services, service governance and strategic outsourced service providers.

* Proven experience establishing data-driven operational improvement capabilities, using service analytics, digital employee experience telemetry and customer feedback to influence product roadmaps and engineering priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Operations, Product and Engineering to eliminate recurring issues at their root cause, reduce support demand and improve the end-to-end employee experience.
* A proven record of leading managers across regions, building effective teams and developing talent, succession and delivery accountability.
* Deep practical knowledge of IT service management (ITIL / ITSM), major incidents, problem and change management, service transition, ServiceNow or comparable platforms, and measurable service and experience outcomes.
* Strong commercial and financial leadership, including substantial operating budgets, outcome-based managed-service contracts, supplier negotiation, service cost optimization and sourcing decisions.
* Demonstrated delivery of operational modernization with measurable improvements through automation, self-service, AI-enabled support, digital employee experience insights and continuous improvement.
* A strong understanding of workplace endpoint and collaboration technology, device and asset lifecycles, field support and multimedia services, sufficient to challenge technical and commercial decisions.
* Experience managing security, regulatory controls, audits, operational resilience and risk in a complex enterprise; experience in financial services or another regulated industry is advantageous.
* Credibility with senior executives and the ability to coordinate decisions across Technology, Security, Finance, Procurement and business stakeholders while protecting service continuity during change.

For Spain the **base salary range** for this position is between EUR 98,000 and EUR 163,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

**About Swiss Re**

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. title: Learning Support Assistant
description:
**About the School - The British School of Barcelona (City):**  
The British School of Barcelona (BSB) is a great school in a wonderful location. We are an HMC school and were judged by a recent BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection to be outstanding in every area, including quality of education, safeguarding, pupil welfare and academic outcomes.
  
  
BSB is a large, very popular school for children aged 3 to 18. Our curriculum is based on the English National Curriculum, and we offer a wide range of GCSEs, A levels, BTEC and the International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB), all alongside a significant enrichment programme.
  
  
Approximately 2,350 students from more than 74 nationalities attend the school and over 375 staff work at BSB. We are based in several locations across the Barcelona area, including Castelldefels and Sitges, as well as our campuses in the heart of Barcelona: BSB Esperança, offering Early Years and Year 1, and BSB City (Luca), offering Primary, Secondary and Pre-University education.
  
  
In September 2026, we opened a new campus north of Barcelona, in the Maresme area, initially welcoming EYFS and Primary-aged students.
  
  
The growth of the school has been accompanied by significant investment over recent years, including the building of a state-of-the-art Pre-University Centre (Nexus), a full-sized 4G rugby and football pitch, dedicated STEAM facilities and the new BSB City and Maresme campuses.
  
  
Barcelona is a wonderful place to live, combining an amazing city with beaches and mountains nearby. The quality of life is excellent with a mild climate and year-round sunshine.
  
  
The school now has an exciting opportunity for an experienced **Learning Support Assistant** to join our fantastic team.
  
  
**About Cognita:**  
Cognita is a global leader in independent education. Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 86 schools in 21 countries - in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East - serving more than 100,000 students. Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world".
  
  
**About the Role:**  
We are seeking a **temporary, part-time Learning Support Assistant** to join our team at BSB City campus from **8th January 2027**.
  
  
The ideal candidate will support the education and social development of pupils under the direction of the Headteacher, Director of Student Support, Learning Support Lead and class teachers.
  
  
As a Learning Assistant at BSB, you will form part of the Learning Support Team. You will be required to demonstrate an informed and efficient approach to teaching and learning by adopting relevant strategies to support the work of the teachers and increase achievement of all pupils, including those with special educational needs and disabilities.
  
  
The appointed Learning Assistant will need a proven excellent track-record of:
  

* Demonstrating an understanding of how young children best learn.
* Communicating effectively and sensitively with pupils to adapt to their needs and support their learning.
* Contributing to effective assessment and planning by supporting the monitoring, recording and reporting of pupil performance and progress as appropriate to the level of the role.
* Knowing each individual child and supporting teachers to adapt teaching and learning to meet the specific needs of each pupil.
* Maintaining an interactive and inspiring learning environment.
* Ensuring well-being is at the heart of our provision.
* Having good interpersonal skills and able to work well as part of a team.
* Being committed to on-going professional development.

  
Join a team of enthusiastic individuals who appreciate the rigour of the English curriculum but embrace the freedoms offered by an international setting.
  
  
A commitment to the wider life of the school, and our enrichment programme, is an expectation of the job.  
  
  
**Who We Are Looking For:**  
We require:
  

* English: advanced.
* Qualification in support teaching and/or working with children with special educational needs.
* Minimum 2 years of experience providing support in teaching (desirable).

  
**Benefits at Cognita:**
  
All positions are offered with attractive packages including competitive salaries, places for staff children in BSB, and other local benefits.
  
  
*What we can offer you:*  

* A fantastic team of staff who are committed, supportive and collaborative.
* An opportunity to learn new skills.
* The wider support of BSB including access to high level CPD and future career opportunities.
* The support of the Cognita network including cross-school collaborative learning partnerships.

  
**How to Apply:**  
Complete this application before the closing date: **9am CET (UTC+1), Friday 4th December 2026**.
  
  
Early applications are encouraged, we reserve the right to interview and appoint prior to closing date for the right applicant.
  
  
Cognita Schools are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.
  
  
We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background.
  
  
We understand the value of AI tools and recognise the benefits they can offer to people who may need support with their writing. However, please be aware that we are increasingly rejecting CVs, expressions of interest and applications where the use of AI has resulted in content that feels generic, lacks personality or is indistinguishable from other submissions.
  
  
By using your own words, experiences and ideas to demonstrate your motivation for applying and your alignment with the role, you will give yourself the best opportunity to stand out in a highly competitive field.

title: Director of CRM & Patient Lifecycle Operations
description:
**About Impress**

We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love. We are IMPRESS, the largest chain of digital orthodontic clinics in Europe, revolutionizing the invisible orthodontic sector and bringing smiles to people's faces. Our unique combination of medical expertise and digitalization has earned us recognition as one of the top fastest-growing Health Tech companies by Forbes. Born in Barcelona in 2019, we have expanded across 10 countries with more than 110 locations, offering leading care and state-of-the-art technology.

##### **The Mission**

At Impress, we don't just provide orthodontics; we run a world-class operations and CRM engine. As the **Director of CRM & Lifecycle Operations**, you will own the entire patient journey—from the moment a lead is acquired to their final treatment result and beyond.

Your goal is to build a seamless, "always-on" communication ecosystem that maximizes funnel efficiency. You will leverage our existing **AI Voice and Text Agents**, scaling them to the next level to ensure that every patient interaction is personalized, timely, and high-converting.

##### **Location**

This position is **based on-site at our headquarters in Barcelona (Spain)**. You’ll be working closely with our international marketing team in a dynamic, collaborative office environment.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

***End-to-End Journey Orchestration***

Design and optimize the full patient lifecycle across all touchpoints (Email, WhatsApp, SMS, and Voice). You will be responsible for the transition between every key stage:

* **Acquisition & Lead Nurturing**: Turning interest into booked appointments.
* **Show-up Optimization**: Using behavioral triggers to ensure clinic attendance.
* **Patient Experience**: Managing the "in-treatment" journey to ensure clinical compliance and satisfaction.
* **Upselling & Advocacy**: Driving post-treatment value through retainers, whitening, and referrals.

***Next-Gen AI & Automation Leadership***

Impress is already at the forefront of AI. You will take ownership of our **AI Text and Voice Agents**, moving them beyond basic automation to sophisticated, human-like interactions. You will lead the strategy for how AI handles lead qualification, appointment rescheduling, and FAQ handling to 10x our operational capacity.

***Cross-Functional Command***

You are the glue between departments. You will work in the trenches with:

* **Marketing:** To align top-of-funnel messaging with lifecycle nurturing.
* **Booking Conversion Team:** To optimize the "Lead-to-Clinic" bridge.
* **Sales & Clinic Teams:** To ensure digital communications perfectly sync with human follow-ups and in-person experiences.
* **Omnichannel Funnel Efficiency:** Relentlessly audit and improve our multi-channel reach. You will decide when a patient needs an automated WhatsApp nudge, a personalized email, or a call from our AI Voice agent, ensuring we reduce Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) while maximizing Life Time Value (LTV).

##### **Who You Are**

* **The Architect:** You have 7+ years of experience building complex lifecycles in high-growth D2C, Health-Tech, or FinTech environments.
* **AI-Forward:** You aren't afraid of the future. You have experience (or a deep strategic interest) in deploying Conversational AI (LLMs, Voice Synthesis) to automate customer interactions.
* **Master of Orchestration:** You understand that a WhatsApp message must complement—not duplicate—a phone call. You thrive on managing "Online-to-Offline" (O2O) journeys.
* **Data-Driven Leader:** You speak the language of conversion rates, cohort analysis, and attribution. You use data to tell the story of where the funnel is leaking and how to fix it.

title: Account Manager
description:
Everseen: A leader in vision AI solutions for the world’s leading retailers.

Senior sales team, product, engineering, operations (customer delivery) teams

description:
##### **Valsea - Where Innovation Meets Entertainment**

At Valsea, we’re shaping the future of entertainment with immersive, engaging experiences that captivate players worldwide. Based in sunny Marbella, Spain, our vibrant open-space office is home to an international team of developers, marketers, product owners, and much more.

Valsea operates a leading scalable technology platform, 100% owned by us. This gives us the freedom to deliver results fast. We integrate selected outside companies into our ecosystem to ensure we provide fresh and vibrant products for our customers.

We work in a fast-paced environment, creating new brands, maintaining and improving our tech stack, launching leading acquisition and retention campaigns, and developing fresh features. Our ethos is simple - be best-in-class in everything we do.

Despite our rapid growth, Valsea still has that exciting start-up feel. We embrace a hybrid working model to balance professional growth with personal well-being. With a dynamic work environment, attractive salary, and a culture that thrives on collaboration, our power is our people.

We provide company laptops and other things you may need to work comfortably. Remote workers are always invited to our annual company trip and other team events. Ready to be part of something exciting?

##### **What are we looking for now?**

We are looking for a Head of Search to own organic growth across our markets and make our casino and sportsbook the first choice of both search engines and AI assistants.

This is a senior role with a clear commercial focus, coming with a proven background in SEO and AI Search (GEO). Working in a small, focused team, you will set the strategy, win priority on the product roadmap and be measured on revenue performance, not just rankings. You will do it in a competitive, affiliate-heavy and tightly regulated search vertical.

##### **What you will be accountable for:**

* Incremental non-brand organic revenue in all our markets: growth in first-time depositors (FTDs) and net gaming revenue (NGR) from non-brand organic search.
* Organic share of total traffic and acquisition, protected and grown in a search landscape reshaped by AI Overviews and AI assistants, and less dependent on paid media and affiliates.
* Value per organic visitor: FTD conversion rate and NGR per organic session, bringing players who register, deposit and stay, not only sessions.

##### **What you will do:**

Strategy and leadership

* Define and deliver the SEO and AI search strategy, roadmap, forecast and budget for our markets.
* Lead, coach and grow the SEO team, and manage agencies and freelancers on outcomes.
* Collaborate with Acquisition, Retention, Casino and Sportsbook Product, and Marketing.
* Write business cases and requirements, and work with Product and Technology to deliver them in the roadmap.
* Run SEO experiments, measure incrementality and report results and forecasts to top management.

Technical SEO

* Own technical SEO direction for a very large, fast-changing sites: thousands of game pages, provider and category lobbies, live event and odds pages, promotions and help content.
* Set the direction for site architecture, category and filter pages, internal linking, crawl budget, indexation, JavaScript rendering, Core Web Vitals and international setup (hreflang, market and language variants, geo-restriction handling).
* Manage the SEO side of short-lived content: live and upcoming events, expiring promotions, removed games and market-specific restrictions.

AI search (GEO/AEO)

* Build our GEO/AEO practice: measure and grow the visibility and citations of our brand, games and sports content in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and other AI assistants.
* Set the policy for AI crawlers and make game data (provider, RTP, volatility, features), odds, promotions and terms clean, structured and accessible to LLMs and agents.

Content and automation

* Scale content with AI: game reviews, category and provider pages, sports previews and guides, metadata and internal links, with editorial and compliance quality control and measurable impact.
* Automate the team's own work with AI tools and agents, so specialists spend their time on decisions.

Conversion and off-site

* Improve landing-page quality and conversion of organic traffic into registrations and first deposits, with Product, UX, UI and Analytics.
* Lead off-site strategy: digital PR, safe and compliant link acquisition, brand mentions and reputation in search results, including review sites and affiliate listings.
* Work with Legal and Compliance so all SEO and content activity meets licence conditions, advertising rules and responsible gambling standards in each market.

**What we expect:**

* 5+ years of SEO experience, including 2+ years leading an SEO team.
* A track record on a large igaming, betting, ecommerce or marketplace site with proven, measured non-brand organic revenue growth. Direct igaming experience, operator or affiliate side, is a strong advantage.
* Strong technical SEO: you understand how search engines crawl, render and index complex, JavaScript-heavy architectures, and you can challenge both developers and technical specialists.
* International SEO experience across several countries and languages.
* Hands-on GEO/AEO experience: you have measured and improved visibility in AI search, and can show how.

* Experience building AI-assisted content and SEO workflows at scale with quality control.
* A clear understanding of the compliance limits on gambling marketing: regulator advertising rules, responsible gambling, and search engine policies for gambling content and links.
* Commercial and analytical mindset: forecasting, budgeting, ROI, GA4, Search Console, BI tools; SQL or BigQuery is an advantage.
* Experience running SEO tests and working in sprints with Product and Technology.
* Ability to present clearly to top management and to turn strategy into tasks for the team.
* Experience in Nordic or other small-language search markets.

##### **What We offer:**

* Hybrid working model (office 3 days/ week)
* Innovative international company that uses cutting-edge tech equipment
* Collaborative teams and agile multicultural environment
* Competitive salary with flexible working hours
* 23 paid vacation days + public holidays
* Private health insurance for you and your family
* Free Online English/Spanish lessons
* Corporate events throughout the year
* Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities

##### **In-office perks such as:**

* Daily breakfast and freshly cooked lunch 3 days a week
* 50% discount on personal training sessions and physiotherapy sessions
* Games room, full kitchen with hot drinks, fruit, soft drinks
* Gym, massage room and much more

title: Head of Retention & Customer Experience
description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention & Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.

We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.

**The mission of this role**

Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**

We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
* Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.

**Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* **Subscriptions and churn:** own the subscription program for both brands, keep at least one save or retention test live every week, grow the share of new customers who subscribe (working with the CRO Lead on on-site and post-purchase offers), and report subscribers, MRR, churn and save rate by brand every week.
* **Email, SMS and lifecycle:** own email and SMS strategy, manage the retention agency, keep the calendar live and flows in testing, keep list health and deliverability strong, and plan sale and launch campaigns with the Head of Growth and the Head of Brand & Community.
* **Post-purchase experience and loyalty:** ship at least one post-purchase improvement every month, and use cancellation reasons, reviews, surveys and support contact reasons to find why customers leave and fix the cause with the owning team.
* **Customer experience and support:** lead the Customer Experience Manager, own the weekly CX KPI scorecard (CSAT, first response time, AI resolution rate, refund rate and chargebacks), set customer service policy, and grow 4- and 5-star reviews.
* **Retention data and reporting:** track cohort retention, repeat purchase rate and lifetime value by brand and channel, report retention KPIs weekly, run a monthly retention review with the CEO, and write the retention playbook as SOPs so it runs without one person.

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening Interview

(2) In-Depth Interview with our CEO

(3) Reference Calls

(4) Final Interview with our CEO

**Salary Expectation**

USD $115,000 to $145,000 a year (based on experience and expertise) + performance bonus of 15-20% of base after the trial period.

title: Retail Marketing Manager
description:
**¿Todo listo para tu nueva aventura?**

En blue banana creemos firmemente que las personas son el centro de nuestro desarrollo como marca.

Por ello, nuestro objetivo es atraer el mejor talento para seguir creciendo en este proyecto sin límites, donde trabajamos para empoderar a las nuevas generaciones a hacer de sus vidas una aventura. Nuestra misión nos invita a conectar con nuestro consumidor de una manera significativa, a través de la creación de contenido, de historias inspiradoras y de productos icónicos de alta calidad, responsables con el medioambiente.

No solo somos una marca, ¡SOMOS UN ESTILO DE VIDA! y queremos influir positivamente en el mundo.

¿Te identificas con nuestra pasión y propósito? Si es así, sigue leyendo y descubre cómo puedes ser parte de esta emocionante misión.

**El puesto**

Buscamos un perfil de Retail Marketing Manager con experiencia en moda o retail que haga de la tienda física el corazón de cada campaña. Reportarás directamente al Head of Marketing y serás quien conecte marca, tienda y negocio en España y Portugal.

Si te gusta pisar tienda, entender al cliente y ver cómo una campaña se convierte en entradas y ventas, este puesto es para ti.

Tu contribución en blue banana brand será excepcional si desarrollas estas funciones:

**La tienda física como eje**

* Convertir los objetivos de marketing en planes de trade marketing para España y Portugal, con prioridades, calendario, presupuesto y KPIs: captar nuevas audiencias, aumentar los clientes activos, generar awareness, vender la nueva colección por género, atraer tráfico a tienda y mejorar el lifetime value y el rendimiento del canal retail.
* Llevar esos planes del retail calendar a campañas omnicanal con la tienda como eje, con un mensaje claro para el cliente y conectadas de forma coherente con digital, CRM y PR.
* Liderar de principio a fin las acciones en El Corte Inglés, centros comerciales, outlets y pop-up stores, coordinándote con Brand, Visual y Retail, y con los equipos de marketing de cada canal, para crear planes a medida y medibles.
* Asegurar la coherencia entre marca y acción comercial en todos los puntos de venta, en el resto de canales y en ambos mercados.

**Cada canal, con su estrategia**

* Conocer a fondo cómo funciona cada canal y quién compra en él: tiendas propias, corners de El Corte Inglés y centros comerciales.
* Adaptar cada campaña a la realidad y al presupuesto de cada canal: espacios y formatos disponibles, normativas de implantación, calendarios comerciales y acciones conjuntas con centros comerciales y grandes almacenes.
* Seguir los resultados de cada canal y campaña (tráfico, conversión, ticket medio, unidades por ticket, ventas por tienda y captación de clientes), detectar desviaciones y proponer ajustes para la siguiente activación.

**Mano a mano con Visual**

* Trabajar con Visual para que marca y negocio vayan de la mano en tienda: escaparates, PLV, señalética, ratio de atracción, categorización por familias y conversión.
* Definir qué necesita cada canal y cada tienda, para producir materiales eficaces y con el coste justo.
* Medir el impacto de escaparates y materiales en el comportamiento del cliente y en las ventas, y aplicar lo aprendido en las siguientes campañas.
* Preparar kits de campaña y guías de implantación claras para los equipos de tienda, junto a Retail y Operaciones.

**El cliente en el centro**

* Entender qué busca el cliente en cada tienda: por qué compra, cómo se mueve y qué le hace volver. Para ello combinarás datos, el feedback de los equipos de tienda y el análisis del mercado, la competencia y las tendencias.
* Trabajar con el equipo de CRM en la estrategia de cliente (nuevos y fieles) con foco en tienda: captación en el punto de venta, recurrencia y nuestro club Adventure Pass.

**Datos, reporting y presupuesto**

* Medir la rentabilidad de cada inversión por canal y por campaña, y priorizar con datos lo que más impacto tiene.
* Preparar el reporting para dirección y comité: cuadro de mando semanal, informe mensual y recaps de las campañas clave del retail calendar.
* Ser owner del presupuesto y de los objetivos de retail marketing.
* Usar la IA para analizar, decidir y convertir ideas en campañas.
* Impulsar una cultura de medición y mejora continua, y hacer visible el impacto de marketing en el negocio.

**¿Qué te hará triunfar con nosotros?**

* Más de 6 años en marketing en empresas de moda o retail. Valoramos la experiencia en entornos internacionales.
* Al menos 4 años como Retail Marketing Manager, Trade Marketing Manager o Marketing Manager con responsabilidad sobre el punto de venta, con experiencia en:

  + Campañas 360 con foco en tienda física.
  + Tiendas propias, corners de El Corte Inglés y centros comerciales, coordinándote con sus equipos de marketing.
  + Visual merchandising: escaparates, PLV y materiales de punto de venta.
  + Análisis de ventas y KPIs de tienda por canal.
  + Cliente, hábitos de compra, CRM y loyalty.
  + Gestión de presupuesto y cumplimiento de objetivos.
* Dominio de Shopify, Excel avanzado y PowerPoint (imprescindible).
* Uso de herramientas de IA para análisis, gestión y reporting.
* Valorable: Smile y Klaviyo.
* Español e inglés, hablado y escrito. El portugués será un plus.

**Lo que te define**

* Te gusta pisar tienda y entiendes cómo se vive una campaña en cada canal.
* Piensas con datos y con estrategia.
* Tienes creatividad, sobre todo a la hora de ejecutar.
* Tienes visión de negocio y vas a por resultados.
* Planificas, priorizas y sigues tus KPIs de cerca.
* Sabes influir y trabajar con muchos equipos: Visual, Retail, tiendas y los equipos de marketing de cada canal.
* Tienes iniciativa, autonomía y mentalidad ganadora.

**¿Te preguntas qué ganas al unirte a nosotrxs? ¡Aquí van nuestros beneficios!**

**️ Estilo X:** Accede a todos nuestros productos con un **50% de descuento** desde el primer día y disfruta de **bonos de regalo por temporada**. ¿Lo mejor? También puedes **compartir un 30%** de descuento con tus personas más cercanas.

**️ Flexibilidad y conciliación:** En blue banana, entendemos que los tiempos cambian. Con un **modelo híbrido del 40% de teletrabajo** semanal y en épocas estivales, **flexibilidad en entrada y salida.** Además, el **día de tu cumpleaños** es para disfrutarlo, ¡aquí lo tendrás libre!

**️ Evoluciona con nosotros:** En blue banana, las personas son el centro. Cada persona vive su propio viaje profesional, con feedback constante, a través de nuestro **Adventure Career Plan** personalizado y formación continua.

**️ Cuidamos de ti:** Priorizamos la salud con nuestro programa de bienestar. **Wellhub** ofrece experiencias únicas para cuidar cuerpo y mente.

**️ Teambuildings épicos**: Inspiramos a nuevas generaciones y a nuestros trabajadores a hacer de su vida una aventura con **eventos únicos** y nuestras **blue banana expert talks**, donde podrás escuchar y sacar inspiración de grandes profesionales alineados con nuestra marca.

**️ Espíritu Z:** Únete a un proyecto con un equipo inconformista y lleno de experiencia donde te sentirás rodeado de compañeros que se apoyan mutuamente. Sé parte de un **proyecto internacional** donde cada día impactas y sumas rompiendo las reglas del juego.

**️ Comunicación y transparencia 360º:** Nos encanta escuchar y debatir, trabajando con pasión y humildad para superarnos cada día. Te sentirás parte integral del proyecto con detalles de nuestro crecimiento compartidos en nuestras **Quarterlies** y resúmenes mensuales.

**️ Oficinas que molan:** Además de **café y fruta siempre disponible**, nuestras oficinas tienen espacios abiertos y zonas de desconexión. En blue banana, te sentirás como en casa.

**️ Sé parte del cambio:** En Blue Banana somos una empresa certificada B Corp. Eso significa que no solo trabajamos por crecer, sino por hacerlo generando un impacto positivo real en las personas y en el planeta.

**¿Quieres conocernos mejor?**

* Pásate por nuestra web o por cualquiera de nuestras tiendas.
* Sigue nuestros viajes desde nuestro canal de Youtube y conoce el lado B de la aventura. No todo es tan bonito como lo pintamos en nuestras fotos.
* Si tienes cualquier duda, escríbenos. Estamos para ayudar.

Gracias por haber leído hasta aquí y bienvenidx, aventurerx.

*Blue Banana manifiesta su compromiso con la igualdad de género y de oportunidades a todos los niveles y para todas las personas trabajadoras, y garantiza la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión en todos sus procesos.*

*Blue Banana promueve un futuro más sostenible, diseñando y produciendo colecciones de una forma más responsable. Trabajamos a todos los niveles para garantizar el mínimo impacto ambiental y social de nuestros productos, cumpliendo los beneficios e incentivos que ofrecemos de sostenibilidad y responsabilidad social.*

title: Head of Partnerships, EMEA
description:
**Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.**

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers. Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* You'll lead the development and execution of our EMEA partnership expansion strategy across key European markets including Germany, Italy, Spain, France, the Netherlands and the UK.

* You'll own and prioritise the European partnership pipeline, ensuring opportunities are commercially attractive, operationally deliverable and strategically aligned.

* You'll identify, secure and grow large-scale partnerships across airlines, online travel agencies, banks, payment providers, retailers, telcos, aggregators and embedded insurance channels.

* You'll build strong relationships with Zurich business units, distributors and strategic partners to accelerate growth across the region.

* You'll lead partner proposition development, commercial modelling, business case preparation and executive-level recommendations.

* You'll negotiate commercially successful partnership agreements that deliver value for customers, partners and the business.

* You'll provide commercial leadership to cross-functional teams spanning product, underwriting, technology, operations, claims, finance, legal, risk and compliance.

* You'll drive successful market entry and partnership launches, removing barriers and maintaining momentum across multiple countries and stakeholder groups.

* You'll represent the EMEA growth agenda in executive forums, governance committees and strategic partner discussions.

* You'll lead and develop a high-performing partnerships team while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation and collaboration.

**What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey:**

* You'll bring significant experience in partnerships, business development, commercial strategy, market expansion or distribution leadership.

* You'll have a proven track record of originating, negotiating and delivering strategic partnerships in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

* You'll understand the dynamics of insurance, travel, affinity, embedded insurance, digital distribution or financial services markets.

* You'll have experience leading growth and market-entry initiatives across European or EMEA markets.

* You'll bring strong commercial acumen with the ability to assess market opportunities, partner economics, operational feasibility and return on investment.

* You'll understand modern partnership and distribution models including B2B2C, embedded insurance, API integrations, white-label solutions and aggregator channels.

* You'll be comfortable influencing senior executives, strategic partners and cross-functional teams across a matrixed international environment.

* You'll have exceptional negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex commercial and regulatory concepts.

* You'll balance commercial ambition with governance, customer outcomes and execution excellence.

* You'll bring European language capability and existing European insurance or partnership networks as an advantage.

**Why you’ll love working with us!**

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.

**Career growth****.** This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.

**Take the time you need, for you and your community****.** We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual, personal and volunteer leave benefits.

**Diversity and inclusion****.** We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.

  

**Apply today and let’s go to great places together!**

title: Event Production Manager
description:
**Event Production Manager**

At Fourvenues, we are revolutionising a $100+ billion global market, powering nightclubs, festivals, beach clubs and promoters around the world. This growth has led to our recognition as the 3rd fastest-growing company in Spain in 2026, reflecting the strength of our model and the impact we are generating in the industry.

We are looking for an **Event Production Manager** who wants to make an impact in a high-growth company. You will work directly with the Head of Events on the production of Fun Business Days and the Fourvenues international events calendar, making sure every event lands on date and on budget, and ends in meetings the sales team can follow up on.

**Location:** Valencia or Madrid, Spain (hybrid model)

**Reporting to:** Head of Events

**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Produce every event in the calendar end to end: brief, timeline, suppliers, build, on-site delivery and teardown, across Spain, the US, Italy and the Netherlands.
* Coordinate the production of Fun Business Days, the industry congress we run in Valencia: 3,000 attendees, 4 stages, 40 stands and 50 speakers, with a production agency by your side.
* Run several productions in parallel, in different cities, and hold every one of them to the same standard.
* Negotiate and manage suppliers, venues, agencies and freelancers, and hold them to the brief.
* Keep every event on date and on budget, and flag variance before it happens.
* Own the detail that decides whether an attendee has a good time: signage, flow, timings, hospitality and contingency. From a 3,000-person congress to a dinner for 8.
* Measure every event: log every contact and every meeting in HubSpot, and report cost per attendee and cost per qualified meeting.
* Brief Design and Audiovisual early, book the team’s travel and accommodation ahead of time, and keep the supplier map, the production playbook and the project board up to date.
* After every event, propose what to repeat, what to change and what to drop, with the numbers in front of you.
* Use AI tools to speed up the repeatable parts of every production (supplier comparisons, run of show, attendee communications, post-event reports), with sound judgment on what needs human review.

**What we need from you...**

* 5+ years producing events, including at least 2 on multi-supplier productions.
* Experience on the production side of industry conferences, live events or festivals.
* You have run several productions at once, at least one outside your home city.
* Budget, agency and production supplier management.
* On site through build and show, including long days and the occasional weekend.
* Professional Spanish and C1 English.
* Hands-on use of a project management tool and a CRM at contact and meeting level (HubSpot or similar).
* Organisation, calm when something breaks during build, and direct communication with suppliers and internal teams.
* You answer for the date and for the budget, and you raise what is going to go wrong before it does.
* Degree in Events Management, Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**We Value...**

* B2B marketing experience and an understanding of how an event turns into pipeline.
* Production and floorplan tools.
* A supplier network in Valencia, Madrid or Miami.
* Italian.
* Having produced outside Spain.
* Using AI tools to automate production tasks.

**What We Offer...**

* Salary based on candidate's skills and experience.
* Annual bonuses for those who significantly contribute to Fourvenues' success.
* A vision and team that will inspire you to excel and reach the next level in your career development.
* Continuous training we want you to stay at the forefront of technology and grow your skills through regular internal training.
* MacBook laptop and high-resolution monitors to maximize your potential.
* Hybrid work model (3+2): three days in the office and two from home if that’s where you feel most productive although we're confident that the environment and the team will make you enjoy being at the office more than you’d expect.
* Flexible working hours. Organize your workday between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM, as long as you meet scheduled commitments.
* Private health insurance to promote your peace of mind and well-being.
* Optional flexible benefits plan, such as dining, childcare, transportation, and discounts with major brands.
* Extra vacation days for special occasions like birthdays, holidays, or unique events.

**About Fourvenues**

At Fourvenues, we are revolutionising a $100+ billion global market, powering nightclubs, festivals, beach clubs and promoters around the world. This growth has led to our recognition as the 3rd fastest-growing company in Spain in 2026, reflecting the strength of our model and the impact we are generating in the industry.

Our vision is clear: to become the operating system of the industry, with a strong financial component and a vertical SaaS (vSaaS) model that empowers our clients to achieve their goals. Their success is ours.

In just three years, we’ve multiplied our revenue by 20x, and we’re only getting started. Our goal is to grow by at least 100% annually, fostering an environment where commitment, high standards, and constant curiosity are non-negotiable. Here, excellence isn’t optional; it’s the standard.

In the last two years, Fourvenues has secured €11 million in funding from top-tier U.S. investors, including Base10 Partners (Notion, Figma, Instacart) and FJ Labs (Stripe, Airbnb, Rappi). This investment fuels our ambitious growth strategy and strengthens our commitment to expanding in the U.S. with a cutting-edge, high-performance product.
