title: Creative (Hybrid) - Design Studios
description:

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

You are a curious, versatile creative who is developing genuine range across disciplines and creative practices. You take craft seriously and bring energy and rigour to everything you touch. As a Creative (Hybrid) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the intersection of multiple creative practices, working with directors, designers, consultants, and clients to shape work that is both beautiful and effective. Versatility is your superpower.

You are building hands-on creative ability across more than one discipline. You are developing an understanding of how different creative practices connect — and how to flex between them depending on what a project needs. You are growing more comfortable across multiple creative formats and contexts. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are genuinely interested in where culture, business, and design are heading next.

You are developing your cross-disciplinary instincts. You are curious about how different creative practices connect and influence each other, and you are beginning to see how your work fits into a larger creative whole. You know that frameworks are the starting point. The willingness to learn what a project actually needs — and the craft to deliver your part of it with care — is what makes you valuable here.

You work alongside clients and BCG case teams, supported by senior creatives. You participate in creative conversations, contribute to translating briefs into compelling work, and are developing a point of view that spans more than one creative practice. You execute across projects end-to-end, bringing your skills to the right moments under the direction of more experienced team members. Your growing breadth is your differentiator. The quality of your craft is your responsibility.

Day to day, you will:

* Contribute to creative projects from first brief to final delivery, executing with care and quality across the disciplines and touchpoints you are responsible for.
* Work with briefs and strategic direction to produce clear, compelling creative across multiple formats — developing your instinct for which approach fits a given moment.
* Participate in client-facing creative work. Attend workshops, support the presentation of ideas, absorb feedback with curiosity, and apply it to your work quickly and thoughtfully.
* Contribute across creative practices with growing confidence, bringing genuine craft wherever the work demands it — and being willing to stretch beyond your primary comfort zone.
* Work with AI as a skilled collaborator. Use it to explore ideas, accelerate production, and pressure-test decisions. Keep human creativity and craft at the centre of everything that goes out the door.
* Contribute to a high creative standard. Share your perspective when it adds value, engage constructively in feedback, and actively learn from the senior creatives and different disciplines around you.
* Stay ahead of where design, culture, and communication are going. Bring fresh perspective into the studio and into client conversations — not just within your own practice, but across the creative landscape.
* Stay curious about the full shape of a project. Begin to connect the dots between what different practitioners are solving and what the work ultimately needs to achieve.

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Reading a brief carefully and asking the right questions when something is unclear.
* Moving between creative disciplines with growing confidence. You are building a clear sense of what good looks like across different formats and contexts.
* Participating in the presentation of creative work, speaking clearly about the decisions behind it and taking feedback constructively.
* Supporting a project across disciplines with reliability and care. You do your piece well and stay attuned to how it fits into the wider whole.
* Using AI to speed up the right parts of a creative process without letting it flatten your thinking.
* Moving between strategic altitude and hands-on craft without losing your footing. Equally effective in a brief-setting conversation and a design review.
* Contributing your point of view with confidence, even early in your career. Good ideas can come from anywhere.
* Staying calm and focused when briefs are open or timelines are tight. You figure out what you can do and do it well.

What You'll Bring

* A degree in design, creative arts, communication, or a related field. Equivalent experience that demonstrates the same depth of creative thinking and craft is equally welcome.
* 2 to 4 years working in a creative agency, brand consultancy, in-house studio, or professional services environment, with a portfolio that demonstrates craft, curiosity, and early signs of range across creative disciplines.
* Developing ability across more than one creative practice, and an eagerness to grow that range further over time.
* Some exposure to client or stakeholder-facing work, and a willingness to develop that confidence further in a supported environment.
* A portfolio that demonstrates strong craft and early creative range — showing that you care about quality and are curious enough to work across more than one format or discipline.
* Practical fluency with relevant creative tools across multiple disciplines, and comfort picking up new tools as the work demands.
* An open and curious approach to AI tools, and a growing sense of where they help and where human judgment and craft matter more.
* Excellent English language skills; additional languages are an advantage and may be particularly valued in certain locations.

Who You'll Work With

As part of Design Studios, you will collaborate with global designers and colleagues across BCG to bring design expertise and capabilities to clients as well as internal teams. GDS comprises a diverse group of talented design professionals across video, content, digital design, and more—all working collaboratively to deliver the most advanced design solutions.

Additional info

We are Design Studios, an in-house creative agency comprised of cutting-edge professionals creating premium designs. We are a global, multidisciplinary team of design strategists, creative leaders, and digital experts. We craft powerful design stories for BCG to deliver inspiring solutions to our clients’ challenges. As part of BCG, Design Studios partners with consultants and clients to shape our brand by elevating our work through the power of design. We offer guidance and orientation through a strategic and audience-centric approach, and apply design, technology, and media solutions to take BCG’s achievements to the next level.

As bold design leaders, we are fresh, punchy, and playful, while committed to delivering premium business excellence. We recognize how to transform complex ideas into compelling visual experiences, and how to activate new commercial opportunities at the intersection of business and design. We value innovation, co-creation, inspiration, and the business impact that design achieves. We believe in the art of the possible and in applying creative solutions to business challenges. We believe we can advance the world by conquering its complexity through a universal human language—design.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

To foster positive change.

* Empower your entrepreneurial spirit
* Cherish the diversity of people, mind, and experience
* Drive innovation with a proactive mindset

**Our Mission: To help businesses navigate change confidently.**

We accomplish our mission by:

* Developing practical, human-centred solutions that drive growth, sustainability, and transformative impact;
* Making strategy and visions of the future tangible as a way to gain and maintain momentum;
* Establishing partnerships across industries for non-traditional approaches and better connected ecosystems;
* Creating strategies that help our clients lead the future with purpose.

**Our Values**

* Long-term thinking: We are passionate about finding the most profound, lasting opportunity in each innovation challenge, looking and testing from multiple angles.
* Meaningful experiences: We strive for positive impact in people's everyday lives by inviting diverse human perspectives and creating relevant and meaningful experiences.
* Systemic elegance: We believe that design can make a real difference when approached with a holistic, inclusive and sustainable mindset.
* Maker mentality: We can't help but make the abstract practical through visualization, models and prototypes to drive alignment and speed up progress.

**About the role**

Role overview

As a Senior in our Business Innovation practice, you will work at the intersection of human-centred design, business planning, financial modelling, and venture validation. You will autonomously lead project workstreams—from uncovering customer insights and framing new venture hypotheses to building robust business cases, operating models, and market launch roadmaps—guiding junior team members and collaborating directly with clients to deliver high-impact strategic deliverables on time and on budget.

This role is for you if

You want to take full ownership of business innovation streams that reshape how clients compete, from early exploration to commercially viable go-to-market solutions. You thrive in collaborative studio environments, enjoy building financial models from scratch, facilitating executive co-creation workshops, mentoring emerging consultants, and defending business viability directly with C-suite stakeholders.

What you will own

* Autonomous execution and content leadership over complete strategic workstreams, several smaller projects, or major work packages within large client programs, taking ownership of content excellence, business case viability, and project profitability.
* High-level strategic storytelling, translating abstract user insights, market dynamics, and unit economics into compelling presentation decks and executive arguments.
* Definition of business models, operating models, and financial feasibility frameworks in multidisciplinary projects led by Strategic Design, Industrial Design, and UX/UI.
* Guiding, supporting, and mentoring Staff, Junior strategists, and Interns on business design methodologies, financial modelling, workshop preparation, and deliverable quality.
* Facilitation of co-creation workshops, client working sessions, and executive presentations.
* Support in commercial opportunities: helping define project scope, estimating effort, and drafting strategic POV materials for pitch proposals.
* Participation in creating thought leadership content (articles, case studies, whitepapers) and industry presentations to strengthen market positioning.
* Contribution to growing the Business Innovation practice, evolving proprietary business design toolkits, and scaling client accounts.

**Methodology Mastery –** Deep knowledge of human-centered innovation, business model canvas, operating model design, customer journey mapping, and qualitative research methods.

**Executive Storytelling & Facilitation –** Exceptional ability to structure complex arguments into clear, visually compelling presentations (PowerPoint/Miro) and facilitate board-level working sessions.

**Project Stream Leadership –** Proven ability to organize project streams, prioritize tasks across multiple projects, and keep project profitability and margin targets in mind.

**Generative AI Platforms:** LLMs and agentic workflow tools applied to market scanning, trend analysis, and research synthesis under strict confidentiality rules.

An appropriate Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Innovation Management, or a related field, with a proven interest in design thinking.

Willingness to travel for client meetings, field research, and workshops.

Straumann Group is a global leader in solutions for tooth replacement, restorative dentistry, orthodontics and preventive dentistry. title: Director of Human Resources — Arquetipo Studio
description:
### **Build what Europe must own**

Building the companies behind Europe’s strategic sovereignty.

Our mission is to originate, operate and capitalise the European companies and technologies our sovereignty depends on.

We are a venture builder focused on dual-use deep tech. Every company we launch is born inside the studio, with its own team, capital and method, and goes to market ready to compete.

We work across three missions:

* **Spectrum Dominance.** Capabilities to operate in, protect and manage data across contested environments.
* **Sovereign Compute.** Secure, certifiable European silicon, ready for post-quantum cryptography.
* **Trusted Autonomy.** High-integrity mission autonomy for uncrewed systems.

Build with us.

### **The role**

We are looking for Arquetipo’s first Head of Human Resources. You won’t inherit a department: you’ll design from scratch how a venture builder attracts, organises, develops and retains Europe’s scarcest talent.

You will report directly to the COO. Your scope won’t be a single company but a system: the studio and each of the ventures born from it, each at its own stage of maturity.

This role isn’t for everyone. If you’re looking for a position with established processes, a large team and a low profile, this isn’t it. If you want your work to show in a continent’s technological capability, read on.

### **What you’ll do**

#### **Talent for critical missions**

* Design and execute the strategy for attracting technical and executive talent to the studio and its ventures.
* Run the recruitment policy, ensuring our talent is aligned with our goals and values.
* Build our own channels with universities, research centres and the wider tech ecosystem, and turn Arquetipo’s mission into an employer brand that attracts people who want to build, not just work.

#### **Organising a venture builder**

* Define the HR management model, tools and ways of working.
* Prepare each venture for independence: its own structure, policies and people team at the moment of spin-out.
* Coordinate employment management across a multi-entity, multi-site environment spanning Madrid, Málaga, Bilbao and our ventures’ locations.

#### **Culture and accountability**

* Translate our values into observable behaviours and real criteria for hiring, evaluation, promotion and exit.
* Design a performance system with clear objectives, identified owners, continuous feedback and consistent consequences.
* Establish a development programme for studio and venture leaders so they lead by example.

#### **Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with employment law and with the specific requirements of the sectors we operate in.
* Drive and oversee the company’s ethics and compliance programme as it relates to people.

#### **What we expect at 90 days**

* Hiring for critical positions under way.
* HR management procedures up and running.
* A standard hiring process, with explicit values assessment, operating across all open positions.
* A proposed compensation & benefits framework.

#### **What we expect at 12 months**

* Critical positions in the hiring plan filled on time.
* An accountability-based performance system in place across the studio and the ventures.
* An HR management model and people playbook that let us launch a new venture in weeks, not months.
* People metrics (turnover, time-to-hire, quality of hire, engagement) presented and defended quarterly before the leadership team.

### **What you need: technical skills**

#### **Essential**

* 5+ years of experience in Human Resources.
* Experience building an HR function from scratch or leading rapid growth in a technology, industrial or engineering company.
* Proven experience hiring scarce technical profiles: hardware, embedded software, critical systems or R&D.
* Strong command of Spanish employment law.
* Experience designing compensation & benefits policies.
* Analytical judgement: you make decisions based on data.
* Professional English (C1 or above).
* Availability to work on-site in Madrid and to travel.
* Eligibility to obtain a personal security clearance.

#### **Nice to have**

* Experience in defence, aerospace, semiconductors, space or other regulated sectors.
* Experience in venture builders, startup studios, groups with multiple portfolio companies or corporate innovation units.
* Postgraduate studies in People Management, Industrial Relations, Organisational Psychology or a related field.

### **What you need: values and ways of working**

Technical skills get you through the door. These decide whether you stay.

* **Accountability.** When something fails in your area, you don’t look for explanations elsewhere. And you build systems so the rest of the team can do the same.
* **You lead by example.** You never ask anyone to do what you wouldn’t do yourself. If you demand transparency or rigour, you’re the first to show it.
* **The mission guides your decisions.** You understand why technological sovereignty matters and turn it into concrete people decisions, even uncomfortable ones.
* **You’re part of the business, not a support function.** You understand the mission, the product, the cash plan and the technical challenges of each venture.
* **You combine closeness with high standards.** You care for people without lowering the bar. You have difficult conversations respectfully, on time and without beating around the bush.
* **Your decisions are guided by our values.** They are the criteria you act on.
* **You do first, then delegate.** At this stage you’ll write policies, run interviews and review contracts yourself. The team will come when the system and growth justify it.
* **Confidentiality.** You’ll handle sensitive information about programmes, partners and people. Discretion is part of the job, not an extra.

### **What we offer**

* The opportunity to design, from the ground up, the organisation of a venture builder that is building strategic capabilities for Europe.
* A seat on the leadership team, with direct influence over which companies we launch and with whom.
* Competitive compensation.
* Working alongside top-tier engineers, researchers and entrepreneurs in semiconductors, autonomy and artificial intelligence.

### **Our process**

* **Interview with the hiring manager** on mission, purpose and leadership style.
* **Interviews with studio and venture leaders**, including people who will work with you every day.
* **References and offer.** We’ll ask for references from people who have seen you lead, not only from those who have supervised you.

We’re not looking for the perfect CV. We’re looking for the person who best understands why we do what we do and who is willing to answer for how we do it.

description:
**Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory (Ref: KTT 2026-03)**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Institute of Chemical Research of Catalonia (ICIQ) is seeking a Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory to conduct *in vitro* ADME-Tox assays and coordinate biological evaluation of compounds within the institute. The successful candidate will contribute to the expansion of ICIQ’s activities in chemical biology, molecular medicine, and drug discovery, supporting the validation of biologically active compounds and fostering collaborations with internal and external research partners. This position will play a key role in establishing and managing biological assay platforms, providing scientific guidance to research groups, and strengthening the institute’s translational research activities at the interface between chemistry and biology.

The position is funded by the ‘Severo Ochoa’ Centres of Excellence programme, reference CEX2024-001469-S, funded by MICIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033.

ICIQ is looking for a Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory to lead the development and implementation of a Bioassay Laboratory in order to be able to perform *in vitro* ADME-Tox profiling of chemical entities within the institute, including: determination of activity against biological targets; screening of potential targets; metabolic stability; assess cytotoxicity, mutagenicity, permeability; etc. The position will support ICIQ’s strategic growth in chemical biology, molecular medicine and drug discovery by establishing, coordinating and overseeing biological evaluation activities for research projects across the institute. The Bioassay Laboratory will form part of the Knowledge and Technology Transfer and Industrial Projects Department, and the selected candidate will work closely with ICIQ research groups and external collaborators. The Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory will design and manage biological assay workflows, contribute to the evaluation of biologically active compounds, set up a laboratory space, and define need of equipment and consumables required for the daily operations of the Laboratory, and provide scientific and technical expertise at the interface between chemistry and biology. The selected candidate should be skilled to be able to synthesise, isolate and characterise chemical compounds, when needed. The role will also play a key part in identifying new opportunities, establishing strategic collaborations, and supporting the translation of research outcomes towards biomedical and industrial applications. The position will contribute to the consolidation of biological evaluation capabilities at ICIQ and help strengthen the institute’s activities in emerging areas of chemical biology, molecular medicine and translational research.

**Responsibilities**

* Ensure that the requirements to set up a Bioassay Laboratory are fulfilled: purchase of equipment, consumables and reagents.
* Ensure the space dedicated to the Bioassay Laboratory is adequate and up to date of all safety and quality requirements
* Set up protocols to conduct ADME-Tox experiments, including: determination of activity against biological targets; screening of potential targets; metabolic stability; assess cytotoxicity, mutagenicity, permeability, etc.
* Conduct experimental work to provide ADME-Tox results
* Synthesis, characterisation and isolation of compounds to assess their ADME-Tox properties
* Explore public and private funding sources

**Requirements**

* Ph.D. in life sciences discipline: Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, or equivalent
* Experience in working in biological assays
* Experience in the preparation, isolation and characterisation of chemical compounds
* Good knowledge of English (written and spoken)

**Valued qualities**

* Good communication skills
* Strong commitment for scientific excellence
* Motivated, creative, and problem-solving individual capable of working independently as well as in a team
* Previous experience in working in medicinal chemistry programs
* Previous experience in working with animal models

**We offer**

* A full-time contract linked to the project CEX2024-001469-S
* Incorporation: February 2027
* An international and dynamic environment within a multidisciplinary team
* Annual salary split into 12 monthly payments.
* Remuneration aligned with the company’s salary policy, within the PTTAGE1 – PTTAGE5 band (32.960 – 41.200 EUR), based on the candidate’s qualifications and experience.
* Flexible 37.5 hours working week
* Free parking available at our facilities.
* Continuous training plan to support your professional development.
* Good connection to public transportation networks.
* Facilities with spacious areas, abundant natural light, and a functional, well‑designed environment aimed at enhancing people’s wellbeing.

**OTM-R principles in the selection processes**

ICIQ follows the principles of Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment (OTM-R) and the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers as established by the European Commission.

ICIQ follows in its selection process a gender equality opportunity policy and a non-discrimination policy on the basis of age, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, language and disability.

ICIQis committed to promoting a work-life balance for its employees and, as such, offers flexible working hours.

The Selection Committee for this process is composed of:

* **Fernando Bravo**; ICIQ’s KTT Manager
* **Elisabet Vilella**, Subdirector IRB CatSud (external member)
* **Marga Nadal**; Director of IDIBGI (external member)

A Human Resources Unit representative will participate in the interviews to ensure procedural correctness and compliance with OTM R principles, without forming part of the Selection Committee.

The evaluation committee will perform the assessment ensuring the absence of conflict of interest with any of the candidates, and will sign a Declaration of Absence of Conflict of Interest (DACI) to that end. In case a conflict of interest arises, the evaluator will be substituted by a different evaluator with similar expertise.

The interview will last approximately 30 minutes and will be conducted in English. During the first 10-15 minutes, you will be asked to provide a short presentation about your background.

**Selection Process**

ICIQ’s selection process usually entails the following phases:

* **Pre-selection:** The pre-selection process will be based on qualifications and expertise as reflected on the candidates’ CVs. This phase is merit-based.
* **Interview:** Preselected candidates will be interviewed by the Hiring Manager of the position and the appointed Selection Committee.
* **Offer Letter:** Once the successful candidate is selected, the People Unit will extend a Job Offer, specifying the start day, salary and overall job conditions.

For further information, you can visit our HR Excellence in Research page at: HR Excellence in Research (iciq.org)

This position is funded by the ‘Severo Ochoa’ Centres of Excellence programme, reference CEX2024-001469-S, funded by MICIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033.

With a legacy of over a century, our unique approach to credit ratings offers unmatched opportunities for professional growth. Embracing a "challenger mindset," you'll join a team dedicated to innovating service to our clients. * Proficient in Excel

This position will involve occasional travel, primarily within Europe.
  
  
**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

* **Inclusive Work Environment** : A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day-supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We're looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment-or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
  
  
Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch's credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Expected annualized salary for the role will be between EUR 65,000 to 75,000 (analyst level) and EUR 67,500 - 85,000 (senior analyst level) per annum. We are looking for a Director, eCommerce to lead the digital commerce agenda across the Southern Europe cluster. Based in Madrid and reporting directly to the General Manager, Southern Europe, this role will shape and accelerate profitable growth across Amazon, retailer.com, pure-play marketplaces, direct-to-consumer and emerging social commerce channels.

This is a cluster leadership role with end-to-end commercial accountability for the eCommerce agenda. The Director will combine business ownership, transformation and execution, partnering closely with local market teams and global eCommerce capabilities to translate strategy into scalable, consumer-led growth across Southern Europe.

The successful candidate will be a change agent and hands-on operator with strong expertise in Amazon and digital retail, a sharp commercial mindset, a genuine consumer lens and a proven ability to scale businesses through data-led execution, cross-functional influence and high-performing teams.

title: Presenter - GCN en Español
description:
**Department:**

GCN en Español

 **Contract:**

Fixed-term cover, February – July 2027

**Location**

: You’ll be based in Girona

**Reporting to**

:

Director of Pro Cycling in the UK

**Job purpose**
---------------

To represent GCN en Español on and off screen, creating and presenting engaging, entertaining and informative cycling content for our Spanish-speaking audience.

The role will involve being a key on-screen personality for the channel, presenting a wide range of video formats, from cycling news and race analysis to technical features, product testing, challenges and practical cycling advice.

The successful candidate will also contribute to the creative development of the channel, researching and pitching ideas, writing scripts, planning content and working closely with the wider production team to deliver videos that engage existing viewers and attract new audiences.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about cycling, knowledgeable about the sport and its industry, confident in front of the camera and able to bring personality, insight and energy to our content.

**Purpose / mission of the department**
---------------------------------------

To grow GCN en Español as a leading destination for Spanish-speaking cycling fans around the world.

This means growing our audience, views and subscribers, while continually developing the breadth, quality and appeal of our content. We aim to inform, entertain and inspire cyclists through original, relevant and engaging video content covering all aspects of the sport and cycling culture.

**Success outcomes (within the fixed-term contract)**
-----------------------------------------------------

By the end of the contract, the successful candidate will have:

* Successfully integrated into the GCN en Español team and established a strong rapport with the existing presenters and production team.
* Confidently presented and contributed to a variety of the channel's regular content and social formats.
* Researched, developed and pitched original ideas that have been progressed into engaging video content.
* Demonstrated the ability to independently research, script and present content to a consistently high standard.
* Contributed to the growth and engagement of the GCN en Español audience through compelling, relevant and entertaining content.
* Represented the channel professionally at cycling events, races and industry activities where required.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Presenting and content creation**

* Be one of the key faces and voices of GCN en Español, representing the channel on camera and across its various platforms.
* Present a wide range of content, including cycling news, technical features, product reviews, challenges, entertainment, interviews and practical advice.
* Bring energy, personality, humour and authenticity to presentations, helping to create an engaging relationship with our audience.
* Research, develop and pitch original content ideas that reflect the interests of our Spanish-speaking cycling audience.
* Write scripts, prepare presentations and work with producers and other team members to plan and deliver content.
* Take ownership of individual video projects where appropriate, from initial idea and research through to filming and delivery.
* Actively engage with the GCN en Español audience across social media platforms, helping to build a strong and loyal cycling community.

### **Cycling knowledge and technical content**

* Present informative and engaging technical content, including bike and component reviews, product comparisons, testing and explanations of new cycling technology.
* Present practical how-to content covering bike maintenance, riding techniques, training, fitness and cycling skills.
* Demonstrate products and techniques both in the studio and out on location, providing viewers with useful, accessible and credible advice.
* Use personal cycling knowledge and experience to provide insight, context and credibility to the content.
* Keep up to date with developments in the cycling industry, new products, trends and innovations.

### **Racing and industry coverage**

* Research and present cycling news, race reports and analysis, particularly around major professional stage races and one-day events.
* Present technical and feature content from professional cycling races and other industry events.
* Use industry contacts to arrange and conduct interviews with professional riders, teams, mechanics and other key figures in cycling.
* Help bring the stories, personalities and developments from the professional peloton to life for our audience.
* Attend race events and other locations as required to produce relevant and engaging content.

### **Teamwork and channel development**

* Work closely with International Content Creators, Production team and other presenters to ensure content aligns with the channel's objectives and overall GCN strategy.
* Collaborate with other GCN channels and the wider Play Sports Network team where opportunities arise.
* Contribute positively to the creative culture of the team, sharing ideas and supporting the development of new formats and content opportunities.
* Assist other members of the GCN team as and when required.

### **Commercial Content and Partner Relationships**

* Present branded and sponsored content for GCN en Español, working with commercial partners to deliver engaging video content that meets agreed campaign objectives.
* Work collaboratively with the commercial, production and editorial teams to develop creative ideas and concepts for partner-led content.
* Confidently integrate brand messaging, products and key campaign messages into video content in a natural, engaging and authentic way.
* Present product demonstrations, reviews, sponsored features and other commercial formats while maintaining the tone, personality and credibility of GCN.
* Build positive working relationships with commercial partners and represent GCN professionally during filming, events and other partner-facing activities.
* Understand the importance of delivering content that meets both audience expectations and commercial commitments.

**Skills, experience and attributes**
-------------------------------------

**Essential:**

* An elite-level road cyclist, comfortable demonstrating riding techniques and participating in cycling challenges and features.
* Good knowledge of, and contacts within, professional road cycling and the cycling industry, with knowledge of its equipment and technology.
* Passionate about cycling, with understanding of its overall culture and audience.
* Native/fluent Spanish speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Good ability in spoken and written English to communicate effectively with the wider Play Sports Network team, the majority of which are based in the UK.
* Confident and engaging on camera, with the ability to communicate information clearly and naturally.
* Creative, curious and able to generate interesting and original content ideas.
* Research, scriptwriting and storytelling skills.
* Flexible, organised and able to work effectively in a fast-paced production environment.
* A positive team player who can also work well independently and take ownership of projects.

**Desirable:**

* Previous experience presenting video or digital content.
* Experience in journalism, broadcasting, video production or content creation.
* Experience presenting technical cycling content, product reviews or race coverage.

This is a high-visibility transformation leadership role requiring strong PMO discipline, change leadership, stakeholder influence, commercial understanding, digital curiosity and the ability to mobilise teams without direct authority. * University degree
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal; knowledge of the local language(s) of the GA an advantage.
* Experience in management programs, transformation PMO, change delivery or business transformation in a multi-country context.
* Solid understanding of PMO disciplines, transformation governance, change management principles, adoption planning, risk management and benefits tracking.

title: AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent 🇫🇷)
description:
**This Isn’t Another Growth Job**
Most growth teams call themselves data-driven. They have a dashboard, an agency and a ChatGPT licence to write ad copy faster. That’s the 99%.
  
  
We want to be part of the 0.1%: a company where AI doesn’t just help the growth team, it runs the growth loop. Every day, on every channel.
  
  
**Then it’s your chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.**
Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.
  
  
We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Head of Growth who can ideate, write the copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.
  
  
**What Ai-native Growth Means At Paradox 🤖**
Our growth machine has to be able to:
  
  

* Generate hypotheses. Read the signals (ad performance, webinar attendance, sales calls, objections, churn reasons, comments, competitors’ ads) and propose what to test next, with a cost and an expected impact.
* Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: it reads and writes in our whole stack, from ad accounts to CRM, landing pages, webinars, email, social DMs and analytics.
* Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, voice, member stories, past campaigns and what they taught us, in one shared company brain.
* Ship its hypotheses. Produce the hook, the ad cut, the page, the email sequence or the funnel variant, and put it live.
* Measure with real KPIs. Every test is tied to a number that matters (cost per qualified lead, show-up rate, close rate, CAC, payback, LTV), not to likes or reach.
* Learn and loop on its own. Scale what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and launch the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment, with its result. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars, wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations and audit our tracking after every live. Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.
  
  
**OUR MISSION**
At Paradox,
  
  
We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.
  
  
We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.
  
  
They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.
  
  
Growth at Paradox means bringing people into something that actually changes their life, and proving it.
  
  
We do that by merging :
  
  

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.
  
  
**Short history**
Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.
  
  
Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.
  
  
We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION 🚀**
As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.
  
  
You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.
  
  
**🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**

* Build the agents that run growth
* ❌ The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.
* Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night
* ❌ The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.
* Build a creative machine with taste
* ❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.
* Build measurement that checks itself
* ❌ The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.
* Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul
* ❌ The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.
* And always: no fake scarcity, no fake claims, real stories told with consent. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:**
you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. Most experiments are generated and shipped by agents. The output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.
  
  
**You’ll own these KPIs:**
LTV / CAC ratio, funnel conversion rate by stage, experiments launched per week.
  
  
**Desired outcomes:**

description:

This position supports all sales team members responsible for securing client accounts. Duties include developing proposals for new, existing, or upsell accounts, managing and leading proposal writer(s), contributing to sales presentations, reporting sales metrics, administering content libraries, and assisting with other projects as needed. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with the corporate marketing team to ensure brand integrity and presence.

Responsibilities:  

* Works closely with sales management to develop, communicate and coordinate proposal submissions and drive incremental business for the organization.
* Manages, coordinates, and facilitates RFP processes including researching, authoring, and editing assigned responses to specific questions contained within RFPs.

* Maintains and updates RFP content library and proposal database. Keeps the content library scrupulously current, on-message, well-written, and accurate.

title: Associate Director of Digital Strategy
description:
### **Who We Are**

Teal Media is a full-service creative and design agency with a conscience. We believe purposeful design can transform organizations, inspire action, and enable progress. Our clients and nonprofit partners are committed to creating positive social change—and we pour every ounce of our passion and skill into helping them succeed.

We offer a variety of strategic, creative, and technical services, including brand strategy, web design and development, and creative support.

We’re a woman-founded and woman-led firm with a team that reflects a broad range of lived experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. At Teal, we value our people above all else and choose to work with partners and clients who share those values.

**Associate Director of Digital Strategy**
==========================================

Base salary $120,000–$140,000

**Put your digital strategy skills to work for causes worth fighting for.**

The organizations we work with are taking on some of the biggest issues of our time. They need people to pay attention, get involved, and give. We help make that happen.

Teal is a full-service creative agency partnering with nonprofits and mission-driven organizations to build brands, create websites, and turn digital engagement into action. We care deeply about the causes we serve. We ask hard questions, push the thinking, and sweat the details because our clients need work that delivers.

We’re looking for an Associate Director of Digital Strategy who brings that same conviction to their work. Someone who can earn a client’s trust, make a strong strategic call, and get into the platforms when a campaign needs attention. If you care about progressive causes and have the digital chops to help them move forward, we’d love to meet you.

**Why this role matters**
=========================

You’ll lead strategy for a portfolio of complex digital marketing engagements, helping clients connect their ambitions to clear priorities and measurable results. That means understanding their audiences, making smart choices about where to invest, and bringing paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content, SEO, and analytics together around shared goals.

You’ll report to our Senior Director of Digital Strategy and provide senior leadership on client accounts and projects. You’ll also mentor teammates and help grow Teal’s digital marketing practice through proposals, pitches, and stronger client partnerships.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* **Lead the strategy and own the follow-through**. Guide discovery, digital audits, audience research, and planning for complex engagements. Turn what you learn into practical roadmaps with clear goals, responsibilities, and measures of success.
* **Be the partner clients count on**. Build relationships with senior stakeholders, lead workshops and tough conversations, and help teams make decisions. Bring a clear point of view, listen closely, and respectfully challenge assumptions when a better approach will serve the mission.
* **Connect the channels**. Develop integrated strategies that grow audiences, deepen engagement, support advocacy, and raise money. Make recommendations that fit each client’s goals, budget, and capacity.
* **Make the numbers useful**. Establish KPIs, benchmarks, and measurement plans. Translate data and audience insights into clear recommendations, explain the story behind performance, and ensure approved optimizations make it into the work.
* **Stay close to execution**. Move comfortably between the big picture and the details. Review a campaign, troubleshoot a platform issue, or help execute when the work calls for it. We’re a small, agile team, and this role needs someone who is ready to jump in.
* **Make the creative stronger**. Partner with creative leads on campaign concepts, messaging, and ongoing communications. Give useful feedback and make sure the work reflects the client’s brand, reaches the right people, and supports the strategy.
* **Keep delivery on track**. Work with project managers, creatives, developers, and channel specialists to manage scopes, budgets, timelines, and quality. Spot risks early, recommend solutions, and keep clients and teammates informed before a problem becomes a surprise.
* **Help good partnerships grow**. Identify opportunities to expand client relationships where additional services would advance their goals. Work with the Senior Director and business development team on proposals, scopes, pitches, and prospect conversations.
* **Raise the team’s game**. Mentor colleagues, share what’s working across accounts, and improve the tools and frameworks behind our work. Support recruiting and onboarding as needed, and bring useful developments in digital marketing back to the team.
* **Balance great work with a healthy practice**. Meet the role’s billable utilization expectations while making room for approved business development and practice-building priorities. Understand how your decisions affect client outcomes and agency performance.

**What you bring**
==================

* A track record of leading complex, integrated digital marketing engagements, ideally for nonprofits, advocacy organizations, foundations, or other organizations working toward positive change.
* Broad knowledge of paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content strategy, SEO, and analytics, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one area. You can connect the disciplines and work confidently within the platforms you know best.
* The confidence and judgment to advise senior clients, facilitate productive conversations, and build agreement among people with competing priorities.
* Strong analytical instincts. You can connect performance data, audience behavior, and qualitative research to a recommendation people can act on.
* Clear, persuasive writing and presentation skills. You can explain what you recommend, why it matters, and how you’ll know it worked.
* Experience leading work across disciplines and helping colleagues grow, whether or not they report to you. You give clear direction, welcome feedback, and follow through.
* Sound agency judgment around scope, budgets, utilization, and competing priorities. You know when to dig deeper, when to make the call, and when to raise a concern.
* A real connection to the work. **You’re energized by progressive, mission-driven clients** and take their trust, resources, and results seriously.

**What we offer**
=================

Work you can care about. Colleagues who care about the craft. And benefits that support a full life beyond your next deadline.

Base salary of $120,000–$140,000. Where you land depends on your experience and skills.

Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage begin the first of the month after you join.

**Health coverage that puts you first**
---------------------------------------

* $0 premiums for employee-only coverage on our high-deductible health plan, plus an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account. Your HSA is yours to keep and use for eligible health expenses now or later.
* A generous contribution toward family coverage, plus a choice of medical plans, including $1,000-deductible and $0-deductible options. We contribute toward premiums on every plan.
* Free counseling sessions, virtual therapy, and 24/7 virtual care.

**Dental and vision covered**
-----------------------------

* $0 premiums for employee-only coverage on our base dental and vision plans, with buy-up options that include orthodontia and larger allowances for glasses and contacts.

**Additional support at no cost to you**
----------------------------------------

* Basic life and AD&D insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage, all 100% employer-paid.

**Time to recharge**
--------------------

* 10+ paid company holidays each year, starting on day one, plus a few bonus days off when we can.
* Flexible Time Off after three months. We encourage new teammates to take three weeks of vacation in their first year.

**Investing in your future**
----------------------------

* After three months, contribute 5% of your pay to your 401(k), and we’ll add 4%. The employer match is fully vested immediately.

**Support for growing families**
--------------------------------

* After three months, new parents receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave at full pay, up to $3,500 per week, to bond with their new addition.

**Location**
============

We are a fully remote team! So any US-based location works for us.

**Let’s make something happen**
===============================

Bring us your experience, your perspective, and your curiosity. We’d love to hear how you’ve helped an organization turn a digital strategy into results.

Teal Media is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know.

### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

If your experience doesn’t exactly match the qualifications listed, but you believe you’d thrive in this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply and tell us why you’re the right person for the job.

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized communities to apply—including Black and Indigenous people, people of color, immigrants, women, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disabilities, neurodiverse individuals, and those who have been system-impacted.

Teal Media is an equal opportunity employer that values a diverse workforce and inclusive culture. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, marital status, disability, and veteran status. We are not offering US visa sponsorship at this time.

title: Director of AI Experience Design
description:
**About OpenLoop**
------------------

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

We are the digital health infrastructure powering modern medicine. Healthcare and non-healthcare brands use our white-label platform to launch, scale and run virtual and hybrid care without the operational complexity. We bring together one of the largest telehealth clinician networks in the country, nationwide payer coverage, integrated pharmacy and lab partners, EHR connectivity, 24/7 patient support and full revenue cycle management. Our partners put their brand on the front end, and everything behind it runs on us. We serve more than 3 million patients a year and power over 1 million visits a month.

**About the Role**
------------------

As **Director of AI Experience Design** at OpenLoop Health, you'll lead design across everything we build: patient and client-facing experiences, our White-Label platform and Launchpad, AI agents and copilots, and the operational platforms our teams use every day.

You'll set a multi-year design vision, grow and lead the team, and own the system our products are built on. That system won't only guide human designers. It becomes the contract AI follows, precise enough that AI tools can build UI that meets our bar. You'll also help designers, engineers, and PMs use AI effectively and at scale, so the team can do more without lowering the bar on quality.

You'll treat design like a business: own the outcomes, make focused bets, and iterate based on customer truth and data. This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of strategy and execution.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Set the design vision and strategy across patient, client, and internal products, and turn bold ideas into outcomes patients, clients, and the business can measure.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of designers. Establish clear career paths, strong critique, and a culture with a high bar for craft.
* Own the design system as the source of truth, not a side artifact. That covers tokens, components, information hierarchy, and interaction principles, with theming across the many client brands our White-Label platform supports.
* Make the system AI-ready. Ship standards as code (tokens, patterns, and components wired into the engineering pipeline) so the correct, accessible, compliant pattern is the default for people and AI coding agents alike.
* Measure the system like a product, using adoption in code, pattern reuse, override rates, and first-pass quality, and retire patterns the data shows are failing.
* Help the Product & Tech org use AI effectively and at scale, with the workflows, tools, and standards that let the team ship more without sacrificing quality.
* Set the standard for how AI shows up in our products, across voice, chat, and autonomous agents. That covers trust patterns like transparency, citations, confidence, error recovery, escalation, and human handoff in a regulated healthcare setting.
* Ground decisions in research. Run discovery and usability testing with patients, clinicians, and clients, and prototype in code with real data to validate ideas before they scale.
* Audit existing and acquired surfaces, such as Hey Revia and Season Health, and drive convergence toward a single coherent experience.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leaders on problem definition, roadmap, and scoping.
* Own design KPIs and instrument the experience to quantify impact. Represent Design in executive forums with clear narratives, tradeoffs, and results.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, with 3+ years leading teams directly. B2B or B2B2C SaaS experience preferred.
* A portfolio showing end-to-end systems thinking, exceptional craft, and shipped work at scale across web and mobile.
* A track record of designing and shipping AI-powered or agentic experiences in production, and of changing how teams and AI tools actually build.
* Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain great design talent.
* Inspired by products where systematic design creates clarity, and you know what separates great product experiences from good ones.
* Meticulous and opinionated, able to hold the line on standards while moving fast.
* Comfortable being both hands-on (Figma, tokens, specs, prototyping in code with tools like Claude Code) and strategic (principles, governance, cross-team alignment).
* A strong command of accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and of designing for trust in high-stakes settings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, able to align executives around crisp narratives and metrics.
* Healthcare or other regulated-industry experience is a plus.

* Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
* Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts
* Flexible PTO

* Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more

title: Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers
description:
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of more than 1.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.

Visit our website at **www.cleanspark.com**.

**Job Overview**

The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines
* Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs
* Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning
* Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate
* Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority
* Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness
* Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements
* Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work
* Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans
* Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums
* Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance
* Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows
* Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership

This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team-oriented, inclusive environment.

title: Head of Growth
description:
**About Lendable**
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:
  
  

* One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people
* Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
* Profitable since 2017
* Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
* Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch:
**loans, credit cards and car finance**
. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.
  
  
We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks
**with dated systems and painful processes.**
**Join us if you want to**

* Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
* Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions
* Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

**Growth Lead**
We’re looking for a senior Growth Lead with deep expertise in brand and trade marketing to shape how Mexican consumers see our brand and to build our in-store acquisition channel. Your mission is not just to grow volume, but to grow the right customers: attracting higher-quality, lower-risk and more profitable cardholders for our Mexico Credit Card.
  
  
A big part of the opportunity is a channel few card issuers in Mexico are present in: in-store acquisition through our merchant partners. Physical retailers already distribute our cards at the point of sale, and the channel is largely untapped. We want someone who can turn it into a growth engine through trade marketing, in-store promotions, POP and co-marketing with our merchants.
  
  
You’ll also own our brand in Mexico: positioning, messaging and creative direction across socials, digital and in-store. You’ll work closely with our UK growth and analytics team, who lead performance marketing, tracking and attribution, and with our Credit team to make sure every campaign brings in customers who are good for the business.
  
  
This role is central to scaling our Mexico Credit Card, a mobile-app–first product designed for credit builders in Mexico.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build Trade & Retail Marketing at the Point of Sale
* Own the growth strategy for our in-store acquisition channel with physical merchant partners.
* Build and run a trade marketing calendar with each merchant: promotions such as a free card with the purchase of selected products or above a spend threshold, in-store activations and brand ambassadors.
* Develop POP and in-store advertising, from concept to production and rollout across store networks, that drives awareness and sign-ups at the shelf and at checkout.
* Launch co-marketing campaigns with merchants through their own channels (apps, loyalty programs, catalogues, socials) and joint offers.
* Work with merchant partners, Operations and Engineering on execution: store staff incentives and training, systems integration and reconciliation of promotion costs.
* Build a repeatable playbook so we can launch new merchant partners quickly.
* Own & Build Our Brand in Mexico
* Own brand positioning, messaging and identity, shaping how Mexican consumers perceive us so we attract the customers we want to serve.
* Define creative direction and lead brand campaigns across socials, digital, out-of-home and in-store.
* Build a creative engine (in-house, agencies, creators) that produces high-quality assets at speed.
* Grow our organic social presence, content and community.
* Track brand health (awareness, consideration, perception) and connect brand work to acquisition results.
* Connect Brand, Retail & Digital
* Design digital-to-store campaigns with merchants that drive customers into stores to get their card (e.g. geo-targeted social, merchant channels).
* Keep the brand consistent across every touchpoint, and provide messaging and creative for our performance campaigns.
* Partner with the UK growth and analytics team, who own performance marketing execution, tracking and attribution, so brand and trade campaigns are properly measured and learnings flow both ways.
* Measure What Matters
* Own the brand and trade marketing budget, and the return on it.
* Define clear KPIs for every campaign and merchant: cost per account, approval and activation rates, and customer quality.
* Work with Credit and the UK analytics team to understand which campaigns, merchants and promotions bring in profitable customers, and how CAC compares to LTV.
* Use results to reallocate spend across merchants, promotions and campaigns.

**Required Experience**
**What We’re Looking For**

* 6+ years in brand, trade, retail or shopper marketing, with senior ownership of meaningful budgets and targets, ideally at consumer brands, retailers or financial services in Mexico.
* A proven track record of launching trade marketing and in-store campaigns with retailers: promotions, POP, activations and co-marketing.
* Experience building or repositioning a consumer brand: positioning, messaging, creative direction and campaigns.
* Strong experience working with and negotiating with Mexican retailers and their store teams.
* Experience managing creative, BTL and production agencies and vendors.
* Commercially minded and data-literate: comfortable setting KPIs, reading campaign results and tying spend to outcomes.
* Strong execution across many stakeholders (merchants, Operations, Finance, Credit).
* Proficiency in English and Spanish (you’ll work closely with our UK team).
* Deep understanding of Mexican consumers.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience in performance marketing across Meta, Google, TikTok or app marketing.
* Familiarity with tracking and data integrations, such as Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google offline conversions, MMPs and attribution.
* Analytical skills such as SQL, cohort analysis or unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback).
* Experience in credit cards, lending or other financial services, ideally with an understanding of credit risk.
* Previous start-up or scale-up experience, ideally building a channel from zero.
* Experience leading a team.

**The Type of Work You’ll Be Doing**

* Plan and launch trade marketing promotions with merchant partners.
* Create POP and in-store materials, and roll them out across store networks.
* Negotiate co-marketing plans with merchants and onboard new partners.
* Define our brand positioning and lead brand campaigns.
* Brief and manage creative work, agencies and creators.
* Design digital-to-store campaigns with merchants.
* Review campaign and merchant performance with Credit and the UK analytics team, and reallocate budget.
* Report on growth performance to leadership and keep the team focused on what moves the needle.
* Help hire and build out the growth team as we scale.

**How You’ll Contribute To Lendable**

* Ownership: You own brand and in-store acquisition end to end, from strategy and budget to results.
* Brand Building: You create a brand that Mexican consumers trust and want to be part of.
* Retail Savvy: You know how to win at the point of sale and how to work with retailers.
* Quality Over Volume: You optimize for good, profitable customers, not vanity metrics.
* Data-Informed: You measure everything and let results guide where spend goes.
* Creativity: You find new ways to reach customers, in store and online.
* Prioritization: You focus ruthlessly on high-impact bets.
* Speed: You thrive in an environment where shipping fast and iterating is the norm.
* Collaboration: You work smoothly with merchants, agencies, Credit and our UK team.

**Interview Process**

* CV Screening
* Intro Call with Talent
* Hiring Manager Call
* Case Study + Presentation (e.g. a brand positioning and in-store campaign plan with a merchant partner, and how you’d measure it)
* Final Round:

+ Cultural interview with wider team leads
+ Mexico MD interview
+ Credit leadership
+ Executive leadership

**Location**

* In-office in Mexico City.
* In exceptional cases, remote may be considered, but frequent presence in the Mexico City office is required.

**Compensation**

* $150,000 - $200,000 Mexican pesos, per month, before taxes
* Potential stock option plan
* All legal benefits
* Private Health Insurance

**Life at Lendable**

* **Winning team:**
  the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies
* **Flexible working:**
  flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites
* **Socials & connection:**
  opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls
* **Health coverage:**
  support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover
* **Retirement & savings:**
  long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans
* **Employee referral programme:**
  earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members
* **Office meals & snacks:**
  enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations
* **Sustainable commuting:**
  cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

***Please note:**
The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.*
