title: Technical Architect – SAP S/4HANA, ABAP & BTP
description:
### **Technical Problem Solver | Solution Navigator | Trusted Advisor**

**Location**: Remote

**Employment Type**: Full-Time

**Department**: Professional Services / Delivery

**Reports To**: Practice Director / VP Delivery

### **About the Role**

Bramasol is seeking an experienced SAP Technical Architect with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, ABAP, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) to help customers translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable, and sustainable SAP solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical knowledge with business understanding, curiosity, sound judgment, and strong consulting skills. This individual understands not only how SAP technologies work, but when and why to apply them to achieve the best business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, client-facing technical leadership role focused on bridging business and technology. The Technical Architect will evaluate requirements, explore alternative approaches, and recommend appropriate solutions leveraging standard SAP functionality, ABAP development, SAP BTP services, integrations, extensions, automation, and emerging technologies.

We are looking for a natural problem solver who asks thoughtful questions, challenges assumptions constructively, and approaches complex challenges with a “let’s figure out how” mindset, rather than simply explaining why something cannot be done.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Business Understanding & Technical Problem Solving**

* Engage with business stakeholders and functional teams to understand business objectives, challenges, and underlying requirements.
* Ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and explore alternative approaches to solving business problems.
* Translate business requirements into practical SAP technical solution options, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks, costs, and long-term implications.
* Evaluate when to leverage standard SAP functionality, ABAP, SAP BTP, integrations, extensions, automation, or other technologies.
* Recommend solutions that balance business value, technical feasibility, implementation effort, and long-term maintainability.

### **Technical Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design scalable, secure, and supportable technical solutions across SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Public Edition, and hybrid landscapes.
* Apply SAP Clean Core principles when evaluating standard capabilities, ABAP Cloud, in-app and side-by-side extensibility, APIs, and integration approaches.
* Provide architectural guidance across SAP BTP services, including Integration Suite, API Management, and relevant development and automation capabilities.
* Evaluate technical dependencies, data flows, integration patterns, security considerations, performance requirements, and operational supportability.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, solution design workshops, and architecture reviews.
* Establish and promote technical standards, reusable patterns, and development best practices.

### **Technical Leadership & Delivery Accountability**

* Provide technical leadership across SAP implementations, migrations, integrations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Take ownership of technical architecture decisions and remain engaged throughout development, testing, deployment, and stabilization to ensure successful outcomes.
* Guide and mentor ABAP developers, integration specialists, BTP consultants, and other technical team members.
* Review technical designs, challenge proposed approaches, and assist in resolving complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with project managers, functional leads, and other architects to identify risks, manage dependencies, and drive decisions to closure.
* Proactively communicate technical concerns, recommend solutions, and follow through on commitments.

### **Customer Consulting & Collaboration**

* Build trusted customer relationships through technical credibility, clear communication, responsiveness, and a commitment to customer success.
* Translate complex technical concepts into understandable business language to support informed decision-making.
* Work collaboratively across functional and technical disciplines to develop solutions that address customer needs.
* Demonstrate ownership, professional judgment, and accountability when navigating challenging customer situations.
* Maintain a solutions-oriented approach, exploring possibilities and practical alternatives when faced with technical or business constraints.

### **Innovation & Business Development**

* Stay current with SAP S/4HANA, BTP, ABAP Cloud, RAP, Fiori, Integration Suite, and emerging SAP technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and modern SAP capabilities to improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to Bramasol’s technical knowledge, reusable solutions, accelerators, and delivery practices.
* Support pre-sales activities, including technical discovery, architecture discussions, solution estimates, and proposal development.

### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Extensive experience in SAP technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong foundation in SAP ABAP development, including object-oriented ABAP, enhancements, interfaces, APIs, and modern development approaches.
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, extensibility, integration technologies, and technical design principles.
* Practical experience with SAP BTP and modern SAP integration approaches, particularly Integration Suite.
* Familiarity with SAP Clean Core principles, ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS, OData, and SAP Fiori development approaches.
* Demonstrated experience defining technical solutions and guiding development teams through implementation.
* Ability to evaluate competing technical approaches and recommend solutions based on business value, architectural suitability, and long-term supportability.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated accountability for technical decisions, delivery commitments, and successful customer outcomes.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Architecture experience across multiple full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or transformation initiatives.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and/or Public Edition.
* Working knowledge of SAP Finance (FI/CO), Sales and Distribution (SD), or other enterprise business processes.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, API Management, SAP BTP extension services, and automation.
* Experience supporting technical pre-sales, solution estimation, and customer advisory engagements.
* SAP certifications in relevant S/4HANA, ABAP, BTP, or Integration Suite technologies.

### **What We’re Looking For**

**Beyond technical expertise, we value consultants who demonstrate:**

* **Curiosity**: A genuine desire to understand business challenges, ask meaningful questions, and explore new possibilities.
* **Ownership and accountability**: A willingness to take responsibility, identify risks early, and follow through until issues are resolved.
* **Collaboration**: The ability to work effectively with customers, functional consultants, developers, and other stakeholders.
* **Practical problem-solving**: The judgment to recognize constraints while finding creative, achievable ways forward.
* **Customer focus**: A commitment to responsiveness, clear communication, professionalism, and earning customer trust.
* **Continuous learning**: An interest in emerging technologies, evolving SAP capabilities, and improving how solutions are delivered.

### **The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a business-oriented technical architect, natural problem solver, and trusted consultant who can move comfortably between business conversations, architectural decisions, and detailed technical discussions.

They understand the SAP technology ecosystem well enough to determine not simply how to build something, but whether it should be built, where it belongs, and which approach creates the greatest long-term value for the customer.

Most importantly, they combine technical expertise with curiosity, collaboration, sound judgment, and the accountability to see solutions through to successful delivery.

title: Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design
description:
### **ROLE OVERVIEW**

Pivot Energy is seeking a motivated individual to join our Technical Operations team and lead the company’s Energy Storage modeling and design. The role covers market analysis, technical vendor evaluation, pricing, modeling, sizing, and design recommendations for our storage (DC-coupled with PV solar and standalone storage) project pipeline. This role combines aspects of engineering, collaboration with finance, operations, and policy teams with a goal of deploying and optimizing our storage pipeline.

The Director will be responsible for technical analysis of all solar- plus-storage (DC-coupled) and standalone energy storage market opportunities, including optimal system sizing. The Director will work with the market strategy, policy, and finance teams on revenue modeling and financial analysis, and with Estimation, Procurement, and Commercial Operations to optimize CAPEX and OPEX. The role also works regularly with project development leads and cross-team leads in Project Development Origination, Grid Interconnection, Engineering, Finance, Delivery, O&M, and Asset Management.The Director will have the opportunity to identify and vet potential areas of new energy storage business development, such as new geographies, programs, incentives, or procurements.

This is an opportunity to join a small team in a fast-growing market at an exciting and expanding company. This position offers significant growth potential at a B Corporation with operations across the USA.

### **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and maintain MATLAB and Excel based revenue projections for solar plus storage and standalone storage projects by maintaining and / or creating new custom tools or using third-party applications
* Use internal Excel-based financial models, determine the cost and overall value of distribution-scale solar plus storage, and standalone storage projects
* Train internal personnel use energy modeling tools (MATLAB or third-party) with a goal of scaling Pivot’s ability to model storage projects and markets.
* Train, teach, guide, and collaborate with external personnel that will review our energy models, inputs, assumptions, equations, and code.
* Work with other Pivot teams on detailed modeling and design and on external quoting of storge model inputs including CAPEX and OPEX
* Support internal opportunity leads from the Commercial team to define project value and pricing terms to developer partners and for utility RFPs through market and project level modeling and design assumptions
* Work with key hardware and software vendors on technical evaluation, pipeline discussions, modeling assumptions, design, pricing, and equipment specifications to optimize project-level design
* Provide design direction including sizing and equipment selection to the Engineering team for project-level design and interconnection applications.
* Support the Market Strategy team in vetting potential new markets through quantitative analysis of sample projects
* Advance individual and team BESS knowledge through structured training, self-directed learning, and educational opportunities across Pivot.
* Build, manage and guide a small team of BESS experts consisting of engineering, analytics, modeling, and other expertise necessary to guide sound market and project decisions related to BESS.
* Support team members’ career growth by helping them think through the market drivers affecting BESS.
* Regularly document and share key insights from energy storage analysis process with relevant internal teams
* Track opportunities and analysis requests in Pivot’s CRM tools

### **REQUIRED COMPETENCIES**

Primary qualifications include demonstrated abilities to work collaboratively within a team, work collaboratively in cross team formats with other team leads, creatively solve quantitative problems, prioritize and manage a mix of short- and long-term deadlines, and professionally represent Pivot Energy externally. Experience in renewables and/or energy storage is required. The Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design must be able to think critically and work with experienced renewables professionals to decipher the needs of a project/portfolio and find the best solutions in each scenario.

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (preferably Electrical Engineering with a focus on power system and energy system)
* Minimum 5 years of experience in the energy storage industry and storage project development
* Experience in the solar industry and solar project development
* Quantitative & qualitative problem-solving skills and strong communication skills
* Knowledge of renewable energy and project finance concepts
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple critical deadlines
* Passion for learning new things through self-directed study and structured settings
* High degree of proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel
* Willingness to work in databases such as Salesforce

### **PREFERRED COMPETENCIES**

* Master’s degree in a relevant field
* At least 10 years of experience in the renewable energy industry
* Experience in energy trading, wholesale energy markets, or other energy economics disciplines
* Experience with Ascend Analytics, Fractal or similar energy modeling software
* Ability to create and modify energy models and finance models using MATLAB or a similar tool.

$160,000 - $190,000 a year

### **COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

The base salary range for this position is $160,000-$190,000 depending on relevant experience, along with eligibility for the company’s substantial bonus plan, with a target bonus of 30% of annual salary (prorated in the first year based on start date).

  

Pivot Energy is dedicated to providing a great work experience for all employees, placing an emphasis on company culture and a focus on our people. To that end, Pivot offers an outstanding benefits package that includes:

* Excellent health/dental/vision insurance benefits with up to 100% of premiums covered by the company

families.

title: Director of Brand Design

Cardiff lends to small businesses. Our customers are small business owners who need capital quickly and clearly. Every screen, form, and message they see shapes whether they trust us enough to apply, finish, and come back. As Director of Brand Design, you'll set the standard for how Cardiff looks, feels, and works across our product, our brand, and every customer touchpoint, and you'll build the team and design system that keep that standard high as we grow.

* Set the design vision and strategy for Cardiff's customer-facing products, internal tools, and brand, in partnership with Engineering, Marketing, and leadership
* Lead end-to-end product design for the borrower journey, from first visit and application through underwriting, funding, and repeat borrowing
* Design internal tools for our underwriting, funding, sales, and servicing teams so they can move faster with fewer errors
* Build and maintain a scalable design system in Figma, with documented components, patterns, and accessibility standards that engineering can ship from directly
* Own brand and visual identity across web, paid media, email, direct mail, and sales materials, partnering closely with Marketing on campaign creative
* Ground design decisions in evidence through customer research, usability testing, funnel analytics, and split testing, with clear metrics tied to conversion and customer experience
* Ensure designs meet accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and the disclosure and compliance requirements of a regulated lending business
* Hire, lead, and develop the design team, running a predictable cadence of critique, delivery, and accountability

* **Experience:** 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 years leading designers and owning design outcomes for a digital product at a growth-stage company. Experience in fintech, lending, or financial services is a strong plus.
* **Product Design Craft:** A portfolio that shows strong interaction design, visual design, and information architecture on complex, multi-step flows such as applications, onboarding, or dashboards.
* **Design Systems:** Hands-on experience building and scaling a design system, and working closely with engineers to implement it in code.
* **Tools:** Expert-level Figma skills, fluency with prototyping and AI-assisted design tools, and a working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and how front-end code gets built.

* **Leadership Style:** Hands-on, execution-focused leader with strong cross-functional communication skills; able to give clear feedback, make decisions with incomplete information, and explain design choices to non-designers. **Must have experience managing at least 4 direct reports.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Industry Perspective:** Experience designing for small business owners, B2B customers, or regulated, high-trust products such as lending, payments, or banking.

**Position Summary**

* We are seeking a talented and experienced Lead Cybersecurity Engineer to join the North America Information Security team, reporting directly to the Director of Security Engineering. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on implementing, configuring, optimizing, and governing security solutions across cloud and legacy environments.
* The successful candidate will help support a unified enterprise security model, including the continued transformation of legacy environments into target-state security capabilities. The role requires strong Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 security experience, practical engineering judgment, clear communication, and the ability to work across Security Engineering, Security Operations, GRC, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, application, and business teams.
* This role is expected to solve complex technical problems, drive disciplined remediation, produce clear documentation and evidence, and provide quality review and escalation support for repeatable work performed by offshore or managed-service partners.

**Job Description**

* Collaborate with the Security Engineering team to implement, configure, and enforce security solutions across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, identity, application, and legacy environments.
* Align engineering work to enterprise security architectures, CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft security baselines, internal security policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Manage, configure, and optimize security platforms such as SIEM, XDR, EDR, threat intelligence, cloud security, endpoint protection, email security, data protection, encryption, and vulnerability management tools.

* Develop practical automations, integrations, dashboards, and recurring reports that improve visibility, reduce manual effort, and strengthen response efficiency.
* Implement and improve Microsoft security technologies such as Defender for Cloud, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft XDR, Sentinel, Purview, Entra ID, and related Azure and Microsoft 365 security capabilities.
* Manage the security of collaboration and email platforms, including proper data governance, secure configuration, monitoring, and data loss prevention support.

* Support endpoint and cloud workload protection activities, including baseline enforcement, exposure review, policy tuning, and technical validation of control effectiveness.
* Manage vulnerability scanning and exposure-management activities across applications, systems, endpoints, servers, cloud workloads, and supporting infrastructure.
* Validate findings, assess exploitability and business context, coordinate remediation with IT and application owners, and ensure evidence is sufficient for closure.
* Drive timely remediation of critical and high-risk findings, including coordination of emergency changes, temporary mitigations, validation testing, and escalation when deadlines or risk tolerance are at issue.

* Maintain clear remediation documentation, including affected assets, owners, remediation plans, dependencies, exceptions, validation results, and recurring problem patterns.
* Collaborate with DevOps, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, and product teams to integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows.
* Promote DevSecOps practices, secure configuration, secure coding awareness, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation in the development lifecycle.

* Contribute to disaster recovery and operational resilience procedures to ensure security controls support business continuity, compliance, and incident readiness.
* Support identity and access security initiatives involving Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, just-in-time access, Entra ID, Active Directory, Ping Identity, and related IAM or CIAM platforms.
* Support regulatory and audit readiness efforts by implementing controls, collecting technical evidence, explaining engineering decisions, and remediating control gaps.

* Participate in assessments and continuous improvement activities to define, measure, visualize, and improve key cybersecurity metrics.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to security, development, infrastructure, cloud, and business teams on complex security issues and risk mitigation strategies.
* Provide technical guidance, quality review, and escalation support for offshore security engineering resources performing defined runbooks and repeatable activities.
* Maintain professional security documentation such as diagrams, data flows, procedures, implementation notes, runbooks, and evidence packages.
* Stay current with emerging cybersecurity threats, tools, technologies, and best practices to keep the organization's capabilities effective and current.

* **Living Our Values**
    
  Our core values shape our purpose and provide a foundation for success, and we strive to put those values into action in everything we do.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID:** R040290 **Date posted:** 11/20/2026

**Brief Description:**

The Director, Global Value and HEOR is a high-visibility strategic and execution-oriented leadership role responsible for defining and driving the global and US payer evidence strategy for pipeline assets from early clinical development (Phase 2/3) through global regulatory approval and launch.

Operating with a dual mandate, the Director leads global payer evidence generation while directly serving as the US HEOR lead, spearheading all US pre-launch HEOR deliverables, payer field enablement tools, and US market access evidence strategies. The Director acts as the vital strategic evidence engine that validates and substantiates the value story developed by Global and US Market Access teams. As a core stakeholder in the Integrated Evidence Generation Plan (IEGP) governance, this role translates target product profiles (TPPs) and access ambitions into methodologically sound evidence generation programs—including early conceptual and global core health economic models, real-world natural history studies, Global Value Dossiers (GVDs), and US AMCP dossiers.

The Director serves as the primary conduit to Clinical Development, ensuring global payer, US health plan, and HTA requirements—particularly those unique to rare diseases, such as limited patient cohorts, single-arm designs, surrogate endpoints, and data uncertainty—are proactively integrated into Phase 2 and pivotal Phase 3 study designs. Working in close partnership with regional teams, the Director collaborates directly with the dedicated EU/INT HEOR team to co-develop HTA evidence strategies and deliver robust analytical packages (e.g., indirect comparisons, network meta-analyses, and adaptable core models) for European HTA bodies and the EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA).

The post holder not only needs to be an excellent strategist, but also be a deep expert delivering projects with vendors, and sometimes doing models etc in house rather than outsourcing them. An ability to create a virtuous circle whereby they use their depth of knowledge to inform strategy, and their knowledge of strategy to inform the evidence that we generate is key to long term success.

**Essential Functions/Responsibilities**

**1. Phase 2/3 Clinical Trial & Early Evidence Integration**

* **Early Payer & Access Evidence Integration:** Partner proactively with Clinical Development Leads, Biostatistics, and Clinical Operations from Phase 2 planning through Phase 3 protocol freeze to ensure global payer, US formulary, and HTA evidence requirements are systematically incorporated into trial designs.

* **Trial Protocol Optimization:** Advocate for value-enhancing clinical protocol elements, including clinically meaningful active or standard-of-care comparators, optimized inclusion/exclusion criteria, relevant treatment lines, and endpoints recognized by health technology assessors and US commercial/public payers.

* **Patient-Centered & Economic Endpoints:** Collaborate closely with Patient-Centered Outcomes (PCO) and Clinical teams to integrate validated Patient-Reported Outcomes (PROs), health-related quality of life (HRQoL), symptom burden scales, and healthcare resource utilization (HCRU) instruments into pivotal clinical trials.

* **Rare Disease Pipeline Evidence Strategy:** For orphan and rare disease assets, design innovative approaches to address clinical trial limitations (e.g., small patient sample sizes, absence of randomized control arms, or surrogate primary endpoints) by embedding natural history data, disease progression biomarkers, and external/historical comparator cohorts into early program strategy.

**2. Advanced Health Economic Modeling Strategy & Execution**

* **Early Modeling Strategy:** Architect and lead innovative, fit-for-purpose health economic modeling strategies starting in early development (early conceptual economic models, headroom/threshold analyses, cost-effectiveness analyses [CEA], and budget impact models [BIM]).

* **Navigating High Uncertainty & Orphan Paradigms:** creative, technically sophisticated modeling methodologies to resolve data gaps, small patient cohorts, immature progression/survival data, and clinical trial uncertainty typical of rare disease and specialty pipeline assets (e.g., dynamic Markov models, Bayesian extrapolation, structured expert elicitation, and extensive probabilistic sensitivity analyses).

* **Global Core Model Architecture:** Direct the design, build, and validation of transparent, fully executable global core economic models engineered for dual utility: adaptable by the EU/INT HEOR team for national HTA dossiers and modifiable for US commercial and public payer contexts.

**3. Dual Remit: Dedicated US Pre-Launch HEOR Leadership**

* **US Pre-Launch HEOR Strategy & Execution:** Serve as the designated US HEOR lead across assigned pipeline assets, developing and executing the US-specific pre-launch evidence generation roadmap in close coordination with US Market Access and US Medical Affairs.

* **US Pre-Approval Dossiers & Formulary Tools:** Lead the authoring, development, and timely completion of the US AMCP Pre-Approval Information Exchange (PIE) dossier, unbranded burden-of-illness dossiers, and US budget impact models tailored to commercial health plans, Medicare Part D/Part B, and state Medicaid programs.

* **US Payer Field Team Enablement:** Partner with the US Payer Value and Outcomes team to design compliant, customer-facing interactive economic models, evidence slide decks, and population health tools.

* **US Policy, IRA & ICER Readiness:** Anticipate US policy and value assessment impacts—including early readiness for Institute for Clinical and Economic Review (ICER) evaluations and strategic evidence planning under the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) and CMS price negotiations.

**4. Launch Readiness & Core Deliverable Execution**

* **Launch Readiness Workstreams:** Lead HEOR workstreams within cross-functional Launch Readiness Teams (LRT), ensuring all economic, clinical, and humanistic evidence assets are fully validated, peer-reviewed, and ready for Day 1 commercial and regulatory milestones.

* **Global Core Evidence Assets:** Personally oversee and drive the creation of foundational global launch assets, including Global Value Dossiers (GVDs), systematic literature reviews (SLRs), and early value communication tools.

* **Collaborative EU/INT HTA Evidence Support:** Partner with the dedicated EU/INT HEOR team to co-develop HTA evidence strategies and deliver foundational analytic packages (indirect treatment comparisons [ITCs], network meta-analyses [NMAs], and country model adaptations) for the EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA), NICE, G-BA, CADTH, and other international bodies.

* **Pre-Launch Observational Research & RWE:** Collaborate with RWE and epidemiology teams to design and execute pre-launch real-world studies, retrospective chart reviews, disease registries, and burden-of-illness evaluations using US and international data sources to quantify unmet need and define baseline standard of care prior to approval.

**5. Cross-Functional Partnership & Governance**

* **Substantiating the Value Story:** Formulate and execute the targeted payer evidence strategy required to substantiate, quantify, and defend the product value story developed by the Market Access team.

* **Integrated Evidence Generation Plan (IEGP):** Serve as a core GVHEOR stakeholder in IEGP governance, ensuring pipeline HEOR and payer evidentiary priorities are prioritized, appropriately funded, and executed on schedule.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Act as the trusted HEOR authority across Clinical Development, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial Brand teams.

* **Scientific Publications & Congress Dissemination:** Develop and execute the pre-launch scientific publication plan; draft and co-author high-impact manuscripts in peer-reviewed journals and present novel methodologies and study results at leading congresses (e.g., ISPOR, AMCP, and disease-specific medical congresses).

* **Talent Mentorship & Matrix Leadership:** Mentor junior HEOR scientists, post-doctoral fellows, and matrix colleagues, fostering technical excellence and strategic acumen across the broader organization.
  

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* **Health Economic Modeling Mastery:** Deep technical and conceptual expertise in health economic modeling (Markov state-transition, partitioned survival, microsimulation, and decision-tree models). Demonstrated ability to construct creative, defensible economic models in data-sparse pipeline environments and rare diseases.

* **Pipeline & Trial Interface Experience:** Proven track record of collaborating directly with Clinical Development, Commercial Development and Biostatistics teams to influence Phase 2/3 trial design, comparator choice, trial-based resource use collection, and PRO/HRQoL endpoint selection.

* **Dual Global and US Pre-Launch Acumen:** Strong familiarity with the US managed care and market access landscape (commercial payers, Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D/B, Medicaid, PBMs) coupled with deep understanding of global HTA frameworks (e.g., EU HTA Regulation / JCA, NICE, G-BA, PBAC, CADTH).

* **Launch Preparation Excellence:** Demonstrated capability to lead HEOR launch-readiness workstreams, coordinate Day 1 access deliverables, and deliver comprehensive GVDs, AMCP PIE dossiers, and global ITCs/NMAs under tight regulatory filing timelines.

* **Rare Disease / Orphan Drug Access Expertise:** In-depth knowledge of the unique evidentiary challenges in rare disease drug development, including natural history study design, registry utilization, surrogate-to-clinical endpoint translation, external control arms, and specialized HTA assessment pathways (e.g., NICE Highly Specialised Technologies [HST]).

* **Dual Strategic & Execution Capability:** Proven ability to define strategic vision at the leadership table while rolling up sleeves to execute and quality-check complex technical models, statistical analysis plans, and dossier sections.

* **Collaborative Partnership with Regional Teams:** Demonstrated success collaborating with regional HEOR teams (particularly dedicated EU/INT teams) to co-create HTA strategies without duplicating roles.

* **Cross-Functional Matrix Leadership:** Outstanding ability to influence cross-functional peers and senior leadership across Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and Commercial without formal authority.

* **Communication & Scientific Track Record:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with an established record of HEOR and clinical publications in peer-reviewed medical and economic journals, or HTA success
  

**Required/Preferred Education and Licenses**

* Required Education: A Master’s degree (MSc, MS, MPH, PhD) in Health Economics, Outcomes Research, , Pharmacoeconomics, or a closely related quantitative field.

* Experience:

* Minimum of 7–10 years of experience in HEOR, Global Value, or Health Economics within the biopharmaceutical industry or a top-tier HEOR consulting firm.

* Experience with neurology assets preferred.

* Direct experience leading HEOR strategy and deliverables for pipeline assets, including early Phase 2/3 clinical trial protocol integration, endpoint development, and global launch readiness.

* Experience managing regional trade offs on evidence needs as part of Phase2/3 protocol development.

* Launch lead for at least 2 assets as US HEOR lead, or country level HTA lead

* Preferred above country HEOR product leadership

* Proven track record serving as the US HEOR lead or driving US pre-launch HEOR deliverables (e.g., AMCP PIE dossiers, US budget impact models, payer field enablement), or significant exposure to these deliverables from a global role..

* Preferred direct experience in rare disease, orphan drug, or highly specialized pipeline programs, demonstrating innovative approaches to overcoming small sample sizes and evidentiary uncertainty.

* Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, overseeing, or adapting health economic models (cost-effectiveness, budget impact, early conceptual models).

* Demonstrated track record of collaborating with regional HEOR teams (e.g., EU/INT) to deliver evidence packages supporting HTA readiness and submissions.

title: Director, Marketing - EUFLEXXA
description:
**Job Description:**
As a privately-owned, biopharmaceutical company, Ferring pioneers and delivers life-changing therapies that help people build families and live better lives. Our independence helps us cultivate an entrepreneurial spirit and long-term perspective that enables us to achieve growth and scale, while remaining agile and true to our ‘people first’ philosophy. Built on a 70-year plus commitment to science and research, Ferring is relentless in its pursuit of science that drives powerful discoveries and therapies to help people build families, stay healthy, and stand up to the world’s oldest enemy: disease.
  
  
Director Marketing, Specialty Care has end-to-end accountability for EUFLEXXA, one of Ferring’s top brands and a mature, market-leading hyaluronic acid brand for osteoarthritis of the knee. The role leads brand strategy and execution in the US, translating commercial priorities into annual and multi-year plans, performance goals, budgets and practical deliverables. The Director stewards the brand’s differentiated value proposition in a competitive buy-and-bill market, balancing demand, access, investment and profitability.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership opportunity to own the complete brand agenda, from driving development of strategy across the cross functional team to working closely with field leadership to developing training and resources that enable optimal brand execution. Working closely with field leadership, field advisory teams and cross-functional partners, the Director leverages real time market insights and adapts to changing dynamics. Partner with Finance, Market Access and Commercial Operations to develop and execute aligned strategies that prioritize resources and deliver profitability. Success requires strong analytics, sound judgment with limited data, and the ability to move between strategic decisions and tactical delivery while incorporating feedback and monitoring results.
  
  
With Ferring, you will be joining a recognized leader, identified as one of “The World’s Most Innovative Companies” by
*Fast Company*
, and honored by
*Fortune*
with inclusion on its “Change the World List,” for addressing society’s unmet needs. Ferring US is also Great Places to Work® Certified, distinguishing it as one of the best companies to work for in the country.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead EUFLEXXA brand strategy and execution, with accountability for US sales objectives, revenue targets and brand performance, annual business plans, multi-year strategy and advertising and promotion budgets.
* Lead brand performance and strategy presentations to the Leadership Team, translating trends, risks and opportunities into clear recommendations on priorities, investment and execution.
* Collaborate closely with the National Sales Director and Director, KAMs, to align brand priorities with customer/market dynamics, define execution plans, and activate field teams.
* Engage field teams to gather insights, co-develop and test appropriate tools, materials and resources, and implement feedback. Close the loop with the field on what has changed and assess whether new resources improve execution.
* Manage hands-on tactical delivery, including field resources, patient/provider support, direct promotion and omnichannel campaigns. Establish KPIs, evaluate the promotional mix and pilots, and manage timelines, expenses and resource allocation within approved budgets.
* Partner with Sales Operations and analytics teams to assess brand performance, account-level segmentation, demand and customer behavior. Integrate quantitative findings with customer and field insights to identify opportunities and guide commercial action.
* Partner with Market Access leadership on access, pricing and contracting strategies and negotiations, preserving a compelling value proposition while managing price pressure and profitability.
* Lead annual and quarterly brand forecasting with Finance, analytics and commercial partners, providing direction on sales estimates, market assumptions and resource needs. Collaborate with Sales and Operations Planning and supply stakeholders to align supply forecasts with demand and support continuity.
* Partner with Training and field leadership to refine product and promotional training, and reinforce effective use in customer interactions.
* Engage customers and synthesize marketplace insights to anticipate changes and adapt plans. Ensure brand activities and materials follow applicable medical, legal, regulatory and compliance review processes.

Requirements:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or a related business discipline.
* At least 15 years of diverse commercial experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry. A broad set of experiences spanning sales operations/analytics, market access, marketing and/or sales is required.
* Demonstrated success developing and executing brand strategies, with experience managing mature, inline products and accountability for commercial performance. Experience commercializing products in buy-and-bill markets is required.
* Strong analytical skills, including account-level segmentation, forecasting, KPI interpretation and synthesis of customer and marketplace insights into actionable recommendations.
* Proven ability to drive strategic decisions with limited or incomplete data, articulate assumptions, evaluate scenarios and options, exercise sound judgment and learn while monitoring results.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions, activate matrix teams and influence without formal authority. Experience building effective partnerships with sales and market access leadership and engaging field advisory teams.
* Willingness and demonstrated ability to manage tactics and create practical field resources while simultaneously leading strategic brand
* Proven financial acumen and experience managing brand budgets, resource trade-offs and profit-conscious lifecycle decisions.

**Ferring + you**
At Ferring, we offer competitive total compensation along with an exceptional range of flexible benefits, personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work. From working hours that respect your lifestyle, a culture that is welcoming and equitable, and the chance to work with the industry’s most impressive people, these are just some of the ways we live our "People First" philosophy.
  
  
**Our Compensation And Benefits**
At Ferring, base salary is one part of our competitive total compensation and benefits package and is determined using a salary range. The base salary range for this role is $151,000 - $280,000, which is the reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount paid may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, education and primary work location. Additional compensation for this role will be provided based on competitive annual incentive compensation targets in the form of an annual bonus - payouts are based on individual and company performance.
  
  
Benefits for this role include: comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with a premium differential, inverse to base salary, to be paid by employees; a 401k plan and company match; short and long-term disability coverage; basic life insurance; wellness benefits; reimbursement for certain tuition expenses; sick time frontloaded yearly of 40 hours, or higher if state or local law requires; vacation time for full time employees to accrue between 112.5 and 150 hours yearly in the first four (4) years of employment, and additional accruals starting in the fifth (5th) year of employment; and 12 to 13 paid holidays per year. We are proud to offer 20 weeks of paid parental leave, learn more about the parental leave offering in our benefits package here. For roles that are not field-based, Ferring has a hybrid work policy that is four days in the office, with the option to work one day remotely.
  
  
Ferring is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Join our team and your voice will be heard, and your contributions will be valued. If you love to come up with new ways to make a positive difference and see them through, you will fit right in.
  
  
We are proud to be an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer (including Disability/Protected Veterans). We maintain a drug-free workplace.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

As Director of Product Design, you will lead the design organization responsible for how customers and administrators experience Menlo Security's Enterprise Secure Browser platform, from the first-run configuration dashboard experience to the policies that keep global enterprises safe. You will set the design philosophy, user and administrator dashboards quality bar, and research and accessibility standards for the entire product organization, and build the team, tooling, and operating rhythms that make excellent work the default. Partnering closely with VP-level leaders across Product, Engineering, Data, and Go-to-Market, you will make design a strategic driver of product direction and competitive differentiation in enterprise security, where clarity and trust matter as much as capability. You will also lead how the design team utilizes AI,how we leverage AI to continue to improve our user interfaces, and build shared workflows that speed up research synthesis, exploration, and quality review while keeping human judgment at the center.

**Outcomes & KPIs**
-------------------

**Key Outcome(s) Owned:**

* A consistently high-quality, accessible, and cohesive product experience across all Menlo surfaces that measurably improves customer adoption, satisfaction, and retention.
* A high-performing, well-led design organization with the systems, standards, and talent to scale with the business.

**Success Metrics / KPIs:** *(suggested; hiring manager to confirm)*

* Improvement in product usability and customer satisfaction measures (e.g., task success rates, SUS/CSAT, or NPS for key workflows) year over year.
* Accessibility conformance (e.g., WCAG 2.2 AA) across core product surfaces, tracked through defined quality gates.
* Design system adoption and consistency across product teams, along with fewer design-related defects reaching production.
* Measurable time saved or quality improved through AI-enabled design workflows adopted across the team.
* Team health and growth indicators, including engagement scores, retention of top talent, and internal promotion readiness.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead, grow, and coach a team of product designers and design managers, investing meaningful time in talent development, setting clear performance expectations, and making timely talent decisions.
* Define the craft philosophy, quality standards, and review processes that govern interaction design, visual design, and accessibility across the full product organization, and build the design systems and frameworks that sustain them at scale.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Go-to-Market leaders to shape multi-quarter and multi-year product vision, influence roadmap and investment decisions, and protect design intent through implementation.
* Establish the organization's research and accessibility practice, embedding evidence-based decision-making and company-wide accessibility standards into roadmap planning and product quality gates.
* Demonstrate design's business impact through outcome tracking and clear business cases, and represent design strategy and results at the VP and executive level.
* Design and scale AI-enabled workflows for the team, such as using AI to synthesize research and customer feedback, generate and explore early concepts, and support accessibility and consistency checks, and evaluate AI tools for fit, risk, and ROI.
* Build cross-functional forums and operating rhythms that bring the customer's perspective into how Menlo plans, prioritizes, and makes decisions.

**Functional Competencies**
---------------------------

**Required:**

* 12+ years of product design experience, including 5+ years leading design teams with managers reporting to you, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS.
* A portfolio showing advanced craft in UX, interaction, and visual design for complex products, and how you have raised quality standards across multiple teams.
* Experience building or scaling a design system and establishing design review and quality processes across a product organization.
* Depth in user research methods and accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG), with a track record of embedding both into product decisions.
* Proven ability to influence executive and C-suite stakeholders, connect design work to business outcomes, and shape product strategy and roadmaps.
* Hands-on fluency with AI tools in design and research workflows, with experience guiding a team's adoption of them responsibly.

**Preferred / Nice to Have:**

* Experience designing for cybersecurity, networking, or IT/security administrator audiences.
* Experience designing AI-powered or agentic product experiences.
* Experience leading content design or UX writing alongside product design.
* External presence in the design community, such as speaking, writing, or mentoring.
* Bachelor's degree in design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Menlo Mindsets**
------------------

The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success.

* **Proactive Leadership** — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same.
* **Straight Talk** — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same.
* **United Impact** — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You align with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders on shared priorities and build the forums that make design quality a company-wide responsibility, not just the design team's.
* **Elevated Talent** — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You spend real time developing designers and design managers, set a clear bar for craft and leadership, and know and actively grow the top talent across your organization.
* **Customer-Compelled** — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You bring research and customer insight into strategic planning, and work across teams to find and remove root-cause friction in the product before customers feel it.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

**Why Menlo?**

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: **Proactive Leadership**, **Straight Talk**, **United Impact**, **Elevated Talent**, and **Customer-Compelled**. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability**.

Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.***

Leadership and People Management

Workflow, Resourcing, and Operations

* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong people-management and coaching skills, including the ability to guide editors with varying levels of experience.

* Ability to motivate and support people through change and evolving roles or processes.
* Solutions-oriented approach to challenges involving quality, timing, resources, workflow, and deadlines.
* Self-starter who can identify unmet needs, raise issues proactively, and recommend practical solutions.
* Ability to work effectively with minimal direction and adapt to shifting priorities, assignments, and business needs.

Qualifications

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design

We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
